body:
| |
---
| | | | [](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=b310a02676fa416bbe199fcb216ee5e2&_e=hYAquTO-AZ13Uk843C5REJ_rdKVRJCaHTOJ6FyMQFkf--BxdGZbqueiAcBP3Mj1zlx1KxcylnAljG1OqurrXwCBd4w9Vzn5FSccEXn2UFaMMt9AgzbZHoRW2CwOsqS7lwnAV3RxVPnVYVLAezgB8iZOP1eN626C5G-uqWmPYg3rVkbxUfvOk3Qs9nhKI_BsjF4V47_8I7aadgtZiO8CPj865nwfw16cmM3ZoEtVBgOceqwj15srMpxBwXgCzefufYT2sCCqHHWusa15LvKizjBZ9qQv_mmQp74C1xDWRSSFGjMUyDuuRYqfSfZPi-bX4vHVJ6BSboRD01bvVa4kFJ0Wu0on0eeAios8oZe95v0NIuKmkXQcftiNxItOvFsvJ)
---

Ever since I raised my right hand at West Point to solemnly swear to protect and defend the Constitution of the United States, I have been fighting for America.

I fought for America on the frontlines of the Cold War, leading a tank platoon tasked with stopping a Soviet invasion.

---
| [](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=b310a02676fa416bbe199fcb216ee5e2&_e=hYAquTO-AZ13Uk843C5REJ_rdKVRJCaHTOJ6FyMQFkf--BxdGZbqueiAcBP3Mj1zlx1KxcylnAljG1OqurrXwCBd4w9Vzn5FSccEXn2UFaMMt9AgzbZHoRW2CwOsqS7lwnAV3RxVPnVYVLAezgB8iZOP1eN626C5G-uqWmPYg3qMsjFXuLua5OSRyKWaFh9hKqLVFAwLRybGCJ7yPwqnAODtgL7lk0yPX-1phDPpvF-zCjeolLKH5nOsa8fn6-uybuI50-HM1qaD5u9dUmU9dJmB0dgeBvN1ac5QMOVqHPzsFPep6fiYiZ9JJ1FPNJeKFizp-NOJvUqKo4GCdBS1tc5QyrL0aFjsSbcdNq3VEVcKDUCQHXUW356zMccqpklg)
---

**_The enemy outnumbered us 7 to 1._ I know what it means to put your life on the line in defense of freedom.**

# **Kelly Schulz Condemns National Democrats’ Attempts To Trick Maryland Voters**
_**Democratic Governors Association To Spend At Least $900 Thousand To Promote Fringe, Unelectable Candidate Dan Cox**_ _**Schulz Campaign Calls On All Democratic Candidates, Dan Cox To Publicly Oppose DGA Interference**_ _** **__**DGA Desperate To Avoid Losing 4 Out Of 6 Maryland Gubernatorial Contests**_
---
| **ANNAPOLIS, MD – **As the Schulz campaign predicted in a campaign memo two weeks ago, the Democratic Governors Association (DGA) is officially interfering in Maryland’s Republican gubernatorial primary to boost fringe candidate Dan Cox. Beginning next week, the DGA will be spending at least $900,000 in television ads throughout the State promoting Dan Cox and his failing campaign. This interference follows a nationwide onslaught from Democratic groups that spent upwards of $40 million to support fringe and completely unelectable Republican candidates.

**[Campaign memo](https://kellyschulzforgovernor.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05f3d1aa190e2cb084d25c5f0&id=b055a2ec59&e=64ac72257a): **_This idea is nothing new, but it has gained considerable steam and financial support in recent months and we have reason to believe the DGA might try something similar here in Maryland. The political calculation is simple – spend resources helping an unelectable Republican win the primary, ensuring an easy win for the Democratic candidate in the general._ Source: CMAG/Kantar The DGA has been meddling in the Republican primary for months conducting “push” polls designed to show Dan Cox as a credible candidate for governor. However, as the Schulz campaign warned, they are taking this to a new level. The DGA has now made it perfectly clear that they fear facing Kelly Schulz in the general election and will stoop to any depth to avoid that outcome.

[Campaign memo](https://kellyschulzforgovernor.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05f3d1aa190e2cb084d25c5f0&id=133dec5d28&e=64ac72257a):_Everything is trending in our favor for a historic victory – we have the most accomplished candidate, we have the right message, we have posted historic fundraising hauls, and Marylanders like the direction that our State is heading. Combined with Governor Larry Hogan being the most successful and popular governor in Maryland history and President Joe Biden’s endlessly tanking poll numbers, the political environment could not be better for a third Republican gubernatorial victory in a row come November._

"The DGA loves to talk about protecting and defending Democracy, but in reality they couldn't give a damn and this proves it,” said Mike Demkiw, Communications Director for the Kelly Schulz for Governor campaign. “Dan Cox and every single Democratic candidate should condemn the DGA for these underhanded tactics or accept the fact they are complicit in their political deceit of Maryland voters.”

“Dan Cox is a pathological liar, a conspiracy nut, and he’s completely unfit to serve as governor – and that’s exactly why the DGA is willing to spend this kind of money supporting him.”

“It’s clear the prospect of losing four out of the last six governors’ races in Maryland will drive some people to do some pretty despicable things. Ultimately, this won’t work. Maryland Republican voters aren’t the rubes DC Democrats think they are and in two weeks Kelly will be well on her way to becoming the next governor of Maryland.”

**[Campaign memo](https://kellyschulzforgovernor.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05f3d1aa190e2cb084d25c5f0&id=955a33ff88&e=64ac72257a)** : _Of course, the DGA is very aware of how crazy Dan Cox is and they have ample reasons to get involved. They have been an embarrassment to their donors, losing 3 of the last 5 gubernatorial elections Maryland. They know with Kelly Schulz as the Republican nominee they would be well on their way to another loss. _

body:
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/16072?t=6&akid=3522%2E878179%2EScG_A5) Listen, this makes me roll my eyes. 🙄🙄

POLITICO just reported that the Mitch McConnell aligned super PAC “Senate Leadership Fund” has already reserved **$24 MILLION** in ads in Pennsylvania.

That’s like, way more than we’ve raised during this entire race. And they're not raising that $25 at a time, day by day. They're just getting giant, unlimited checks from unnamed, ultra-rich donors.

That really sucks!

Like, seriously? If you’re Mitch McConnell + you see our campaign’s hard-won grassroots strength, you just ring up your super PAC and pour $24 million into PA, and you can change the stakes of the race???

Look, I know I’ve asked each + every one of you for a lot lately. It’s expensive to run a campaign like ours. But I’ve never needed support more than right now. We don’t take a cent from corporate super PACS, so it’s up to US to stand up to the GOP’s unlimited dark money.

**Will you split your best donation — maybe even $5 or more — today between my campaign and Voter Protection Project to help us fight back against the GOP’s super PACs? Here’s the best link to give:**
[**https://act.protectvoting.org/go/Elect-Fetterman**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/16072?t=7&akid=3522%2E878179%2EScG_A5) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between John Fetterman and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $5 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/16073?t=8&akid=3522%2E878179%2EScG_A5)

I hate how much money is in our politics these days. But in order to win on the issues we care about, I need to be able to respond to the record-shattering hauls of money coming our way.

If you trust me with a donation today, I promise I will fight like hell for you in the U.S. Senate. 🙏

Thank you for sticking by me. It means a lot to be surrounded by so many good people through the good and bad times. I really couldn’t do this without you.

John

| | | I'd like to award you a ⭐️ gold star sticker if you can finish this sentence: "Those who don’t learn from the past are _________" Did you get it? I’ll reveal the answer in just a minute. But here’s the problem. Today our country is full of socialists and supporters of big government who are repeating the mistakes of the past because they never learned them. **The way we teach kids American history is totally upside down,** which is why I am ecstatic to share a new resource that every freedom-loving family needs to get to their kids to help them learn the amazing ideas from American history. So did you get the gold star? Here’s the full sentence: _Those who don't learn from the past are doomed to repeat it_. The problem is that young people are not are not taught to learn **_from_** the past. They are simply taught **_about_** the past. That's the message I share in this video, where I reveal our solution — a new children's book that teaches American history the right way. (Scroll down to see a sample.)

This powerful book solves a **critical problem that other history books for kids all have**. Other books... **❌** Focus on superficial facts, such as dates and names of places and battles **❌** Gloss over the Founding Fathers' ideas that revolutionized America and the world

**❌** Don't help young readers understand why what happened 250 years ago is relevant to our world today

In stark contrast to these boring history books, our A _merica's History_ stories...

✅ Help young readers understand history more deeply by immersing them in the stories around the events

✅ Teach the inspiring ideas of America's founding and how those ideas are relevant to their lives today

✅ Challenge your children to learn from the past and apply those ideas to our world

✅ Are filled with examples about how the lessons of history are relevant to us today

✅ Are enjoyable to read as a family and turn history into an engaging story for kids of all ages

name: Morton Blackwell
subject: Urgent scholarship request for young conservatives
body:
I have an urgent request on behalf of 50 young conservatives. Please help them. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c9371%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=BTt4y1cC4mqBG%2fx4RKVwdA&sysid=1)
I have an urgent request on behalf of 50 young conservatives. Please help them.
|
---
| | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c36100%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=IhpH3kAdnGOQPKHI2QMmbQ&sysid=1) Fellow Conservative, I have an urgent request on behalf of 50 young conservatives. Please help them. My name is Morton Blackwell, president of the **Leadership Institute**. This organization is America’s premier training organization for conservatives. The Leadership Institute’s flagship training programs is coming up in a few days. This National Youth Leadership School provides the “bootcamp of politics” for young conservatives. Here, we help college students become the next generation of conservative leaders. **My staff just sent me an urgent email to let me know the demand to attend this special training greatly exceeded expectations.** More than 350 dedicated conservative students have applied to attend. This would be by far my largest Youth Leadership School ever. My staff secured the faculty resources and classroom space to meet the high demand. **But the rise in travel costs from inflation have exhausted the student scholarship funds.** The Leadership Institute provides scholarships to students to cover all travel and housing costs to attend this crucial training in Arlington, Virginia. As I see it, **financial burdens should never hold a young person back from learning to champion the principles that make America great. I hope you’ll agree with me on that.** The students applying for this program are some of the best and brightest young conservatives in America. They’re eager to spend their 4th of July weekend to learn to make a difference for their principles. These young people are the future leaders of our conservative movement and our country. I don’t want to have to turn a single one of them away because they can’t afford to travel here for their training. Here’s where you come in. **Will you make a special gift right now to make sure every young conservative who wants to can afford to attend this crucial training?** [ **Yes, I'll give a special gift for the scholarship fund** ](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c36101%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=2wIMytdZrpYbmNVH54lsLA&sysid=1) Due to inflation, the total cost for a student scholarship has risen to $1,200 for travel and housing. That’s a significant amount for any one person to give, so I’m asking many other generous conservatives besides you. My goal today is to have 50 conservatives step up to give gifts of $25 each to cover the cost of one more student scholarship. **Will you give $25, or whatever your best gift may be, to help fund a student scholarship?** If so, please use this link to give online right away: [**https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/yls-scholarship**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c36102%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=zyZJmUMtbF6v%2fWlOMAKz1A&sysid=1) Thank you for considering this urgent request to help young conservatives grow into the next generation of conservative leaders for America. Cordially, **Morton C. Blackwell**
President, Leadership Institute
---
| | The Leadership Institute 1101 N. Highland St. Steven P.J. Wood Building Arlington VA 22201 United States
---

| | Dear Fellow American,
"The Constitution is kind of trash."
That's what a guest--with an Ivy League degree--said recently on a highly-rated daytime talk show.
You've likely seen how "progressives" in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation's principles of limited government and personal liberty with outrageous statements like "The Constitution is kind of trash."
And like that television pundit I mentioned, they are pushing a narrative that our Constitution is **flawed** , **outdated** , and **incapable** of dealing with the challenges of our time.
Thankfully, a few early champions of the Constitution--Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison--gave you and me the perfect guide to understanding its timeless principles: _The Federalist Papers_.
---
| | Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution.
Thomas Jefferson described them as "the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written."
And these documents are just as relevant today as they were back then. If we're serious about solving the current issues in our country, we shouldn't run from them. We should embrace them.
**That 's why I want to send you our entire 10-lesson course, ["_The Federalist Papers_ ,"](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60410770:W7MYC1hHN:m:1:2532013465:48AD452582DA93AE7BEC2C9ED234930E:r)**** on DVD today when you make a tax-deductible donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**

---
| | _**" The Federalist Papers"**_ course comes in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or a small group.
You might also find it useful for a homeschool curriculum or personal study. Hillsdale's faculty teach the course, and it will deepen your understanding of this incredibly relevant document even more.
These DVDs also make a great gift for someone unfamiliar with our nation's founding principles--maybe even a friend or family member.
But supplies are limited. So, be sure to get this special edition of _**" The Federalist Papers"**_ on DVD today. More than 200,000 people have already taken this course, so this DVD box set won't last long.

subject: The left broke American history education - so we're fixing it
body:
A new book helps families teach true history
[View this message in your browser](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zbvvpu26be4cjunnoe9d09lsaoq2mbmsdl5jn9ng_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk5p7atdge5p78d5jmeqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbq6ecb3c5ie2ttlc5hras9kelpjcc9l68oj1ppkc9hn6thme9pmaphl65gm2d37mv970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj666obbd1nmti6cc3kmkomfc5lclp238h1e8he4933clhmao71cpie4oh5u)

| | | I'd like to award you a ⭐️ gold star sticker if you can finish this sentence: "Those who don’t learn from the past are _________" Did you get it? I’ll reveal the answer in just a minute. But here’s the problem. Today our country is full of socialists and supporters of big government who are repeating the mistakes of the past because they never learned them. **The way we teach kids American history is totally upside down,** which is why I am ecstatic to share a new resource that every freedom-loving family needs to get to their kids to help them learn the amazing ideas from American history. So did you get the gold star? Here’s the full sentence: _Those who don't learn from the past are doomed to repeat it_. The problem is that young people are not are not taught to learn **_from_** the past. They are simply taught **_about_** the past. That's the message I share in this video, where I reveal our solution — a new children's book that teaches American history the right way. (Scroll down to see a sample.)
---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zd4gibcont9t1atn5ss66c7s51o7p0bvdunqh6m8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3clge2pj4s9h2bs)
---
| _Click the image to watch the video._ We've created a [240-page, fully illustrated storybook](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zusq2c96v972e10mroj6atg5v4vfn245or7uqsio_rp22sh2s8i66pb3clge2pj4s9h2bs) for kids age 7-13 that teaches the inspiring stories of our country's founding. This powerful book solves a **critical problem that other history books for kids all have**. Other books... **❌** Focus on superficial facts, such as dates and names of places and battles **❌** Gloss over the Founding Fathers' ideas that revolutionized America and the world

**❌** Don't help young readers understand why what happened 250 years ago is relevant to our world today

In stark contrast to these boring history books, our A _merica's History_ stories...

✅ Help young readers understand history more deeply by immersing them in the stories around the events

✅ Teach the inspiring ideas of America's founding and how those ideas are relevant to their lives today

✅ Challenge your children to learn from the past and apply those ideas to our world

✅ Are filled with examples about how the lessons of history are relevant to us today

✅ Are enjoyable to read as a family and turn history into an engaging story for kids of all ages
---

| You've no doubt heard about the Tuttle Twins before. We've sold over 4 million books! Glenn Beck promotes our books on his show every day, and we're often featured in media across the country because our books teach the ideas that America was built upon. Schools no longer teach these ideas. (Even worse, many attack them.) That's why it's up to parents and grandparents to do it. But you're not alone — our team has books, curriculum, and more to help support the young ones in your life and make sure they learn how the world really works. Like me, you don't want your children to repeat the mistakes of the past. You want them to help save our country and make the future brighter. That means they need to learn from the past. And that's what our new 240-page book help them do. Here are some sample pages. (Click the button above to download a full chapter FREE to see more for yourself!)

STATEMENT ON CONGRESSIONAL CAMPAIGN
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE JUNE 30, 2022 Info@lanciaforcongress.com
CRANSTON, RI- Retired Navy Chaplain and Republican Congressional Candidate, Robert "Bob" Lancia, comments on his Second Congressional Campaign:
"The past three years running for the Rhode Island Congressional District 2 office has truly been an honor and such a pleasure meeting so many Rhode Islanders in my efforts to be an effective voice for the people.
The kindness and support given to both me and my wife Maryann, as we traveled throughout the State together has been so heartwarming.
In politics, a day of reconning always comes and this week has been the time for reflection to decide what is best for my supporters, my well-wishers, the citizens of District 2, my wife Maryann, and the Republican Party as well.
After asking the good Lord for guidance, talking life decisions over with my wife, national supporters, as well as with the Rhode Island Republican Party leadership.
I have decided to stay very active in politics, in one way or another, to make sure the voices who have reached out to me are not left out of any conversations.
With that said, I have made the hardest decision of my life and decided that this time in history is not the right time for me, therefore, I will not be continuing my campaign for the Rhode Island Congressional District 2 seat.
I know many of my supporters will be shocked, disappointed and some even heartbroken over this decision. We, as America First Patriots, must stay engaged and ensure that, as the Republican Party and its candidates move forward, they all do so with Constitutional purpose and ensuring the integrity of the election system.
I look forward to helping elect Rhode Island Republicans up and down the ticket this November."
###

Hi team,

You may have heard that the NDRC has announced our initial 2022 Democracy Targets ahead of this fall's elections. I'm following up to explain why investing in these targets is so important to our work ahead.

[_Before I continue, will you please rush a donation to help the NDRC invest in all of our efforts to end gerrymandering?_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/47181712/353377927/792749532?amount=20&refcode=20220630.1r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImUxMjg5ZTJlLTZjZjgtZWMxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=cvvcifUQv2XDrv6hCMgE_6XgAOZ-iAnJyILmGij_LzU=)

When we launched the NDRC in 2017, we knew that securing fair maps would be a multi-year fight and that it wouldn't take one redistricting cycle alone. But **we didn't know how far the GOP would go** to cling to their manipulated maps and undermine our democracy more broadly.

So the NDRC has had to expand both our timeline and our scope of work. Redistricting no longer ends once the last state has adopted its maps; Republicans have admitted that they see it as a battle that continues year after year. And to defend democracy from right-wing attacks on fair maps, the freedom to vote, elections and election workers, and even the truth (including the truth about who won the 2020 presidential election), **we now have to fight on more fronts than we ever imagined back in 2017**.

That's why I'm grateful to [_you, team, for being there when we've asked and donating when you can_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/47181713/353377928/792749532?amount=20&refcode=20220630.1r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImUxMjg5ZTJlLTZjZjgtZWMxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=cvvcifUQv2XDrv6hCMgE_6XgAOZ-iAnJyILmGij_LzU=).

The 2022 elections will be critical to keeping our fight going and protecting our hard-earned victories. The NDRC is planning to target races in at least **17 states** where we can help protect fair elections, hold Republicans accountable for their cheating, and support democracy-upholding Democrats. Our goal is to invest in gubernatorial races, state legislative races, state supreme court races, and other important statewide and relevant local races all over the country.

But here's the deal: **How much we'll be able to do in the fight for fair maps depends on the support of this community.**

That's why I'm asking for your help today. We've achieved so much together, but the threat to our system of government, and our fundamental values, is more real than ever. We simply can't give up, and we can't stop fighting. Not now, not ever.

Peter, today is the day.
Peter, Today is our major, campaign finance deadline. This is it. We need your _**[Critical June Deadline Donation Here Today.](http://www.mmsend55.com/link.cfm?r=yxlSxbwljmC1i2XwJp33cw~~&pe=lq7SELJNb3iTRAv0a11knPLfuwX0KIpRJm_K9FtDEfVi3AmRl2J6NZJ9V_kjSlaYK7pB2tkKBDubzWBWyg9TEA~~&t=Mivhs3ax0gF4lMdgRKnq8Q~~)**_ We must win because Jared Golden is not the moderate he pretends to be:
* **Jared Golden has voted repeatedly against expanding oil and gas supplies** , against ending Biden's moratorium on the Keystone Pipeline project, and to keep draconian anti-oil and gas policies in place. When you look at the price at the pump it is not just Joe Biden who did that, it is Jared Golden standing right there with him. Golden's is driving up the cost of gas and the price to heat your home.

* **Jared Golden votes with Nancy Pelosi more than 80% of the time.** While he claims to have opposed Nancy Pelosi his real votes prove otherwise. Not only is he a reliable Pelosi vote on policy, Golden's has benefited from millions and millions of dollars of Pelosi political ad spending in each of his campaigns.

body:
I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of A
[View this message in your browser](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zd13k8ebkr05ghqi5q9a535ukhvp290jlh2ra270_rp22sh2s8i66pb3clie4pj5c3h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2sjlemo72sjk6ipr7d9neppqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65spncgr63dlmmdo74sbgsirbfd9lm9pbdd71ctgb6p1l61hm3cpkm6qe8s74epo6fkjge9i3cc5icpp78cbmc3gb8p9gs2qj2p76cpj33c5lmgo7eoj661qbbd37m2qmash5u)
[](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zd1eek7mhlcfq0jjm1pbtmoj5iaer59k4vo9eu7g_rp22sh2s8i66pb3clie4pj5c3h2bs)

Friend,

**I am a Black man, and I 'm telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America - _Black Lives Matter_.**

Now, I know what you're thinking... _What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis?_

I ask, "what about them is influential?!"

This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities?

No. They aren't, but BLM is.

BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations.

I saw the hypocrisy long ago. **That 's why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. **

**BLEXIT** is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

_Our message to America 's black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture_.

I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I'll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support.

[_**Can you please support BLEXIT by sending a gift of $5, $10, $20.22, $100, or any amount you can afford today? Click here to donate >>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z0g9jseas26gp6sjvjqtrtg5flnkh8in2iknl72g_rp22sh2s8i66pb3clie4pj5c3h2bs)

**How I Started BLEXIT**

I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans.

With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me.

This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever.

I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM.

Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the "Black Lives Matter" organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn't have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others.

Now, I'm giving back to the Black community to make sure they don't become bought into this toxic victimhood mentality that BLM pushes.

[_**Can you help me reach Black neighborhoods with a message of individualism, freedom, and entrepreneurship? Click here to donate any amount >>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2za8d1pu9ru5n5fo6r947bqe24aau9916261jjp2o_rp22sh2s8i66pb3clie4pj5c3h2bs)

BLM incites lawlessness. BLEXIT stands for the rule of law.

BLM destroys communities. BLEXIT empowers them.

BLM only sees the color of your skin. BLEXIT sees character.

BLM wants to disrupt families. BLEXT values the nuclear family.

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

**Here 's how you can help:**

_I am looking to raise $83,000 online to support BLEXIT during this critical year. We must expand our chapters, build new leaders, and reach people within Black communities_.

This is a long game we are playing. If this were a football game, we would only be in the 1st quarter.

BLM thinks they speak for Black communities, but we are taking over quickly and providing real opportunities for our members.

| | | Roe v. Wade is gone. It’s urgent that President Biden make clear his specific plans to ensure people can get abortion care. [ADD YOUR NAME: Tell Biden to Act NOW for Abortion Justice>>](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta89dcd54-0c20-41e1-ba31-49afb0651017/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) The Supreme Court ruling spares no one and the harm will fall hardest on people of color working to make ends meet. We need specific, bold plans and nothing less than the whole of government response that President Biden has promised. We need policies that ensure:
* Abortion care is available without unnecessary hurdles or stigma for people of color working to make ends meet, young folks, LGBTQ and gender non-binary people.
* Abortion care is accessible for immigrants without fear of deportation or detention.
* Abortion care is available in the communities where we live.
* Abortion care, especially medication abortion, is provided in ways that make sense for people who need abortions.
* Abortion care is covered by all public and private health insurance plans.

Make sure President Biden hears from you directly. Abortion justice can’t wait. [SIGN THE PETITION: Tell Biden to Act NOW for Abortion Justice>>](https://default.salsalabs.org/T905c17e7-50f4-48e9-b7d6-ed4ce6dccd41/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

The Supreme Court ruling spares no one and the harm will fall hardest on people of color working to make ends meet. We need specific, bold plans and nothing less than the whole of government response that President Biden has promised. We need policies that ensure: Abortion care is available without unnecessary hurdles or stigma for people of color working to make ends meet, young folks, LGBTQ and gender non-binary people. Abortion care is accessible for immigrants without fear of deportation or detention. Abortion care is available in the communities where we live. Abortion care, especially medication abortion, is provided in ways that make sense for people who need abortions. Abortion care is covered by all public and private health insurance plans. Make sure President Biden hears from you directly. body:
I can’t do this alone.
#
Peter,
I wanted to share an update with you on where we stand after the Supreme Court overturned _Roe_ last week.

body:
Dear Friends,

When I first met Hillary Clinton, I was just 12 years old. Since then, Secretary Clinton has been a personal role model and mentor for me – just as she has been for so many other Americans. That’s why her endorsement of my candidacy to serve our community in Congress means so much to me!

Secretary Clinton taught me to stand up and fight for what I believe in. To also support people in need. And to find allies who will help get the job done when we’re faced with the toughest tasks.

Last week, the Supreme Court ruled against New York’s gun safety law and overturned Roe v. Wade. This week, we heard even more harrowing testimony during the January 6th Committee hearings.

With our fundamental rights, our safety, and our democracy on the line, Secretary Clinton’s example of leadership and commitment to Democratic principles ring more true now than has ever been the
case.

Tonight is our final end-of-quarter fundraising deadline before the August primary. If you stand with me and Secretary Clinton on the critical importance of fighting for reproductive rights, gun violence
prevention measures, and the preservation of our democracy, please click here to contribute to our campaign for Congress. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jm-email-june-eoq]

With your support, I’m ready to get to work.
If you’re with us, please click here to chip in and support our campaign. Thank you for your incredible and continued support. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jm-email-june-eoq]
Warmly,
Jared

Friend,
$5.
If you donated that right now, it would make all the difference in our fight to keep this seat blue and protect Democratic control of the Senate.
I know one donation may not sound like a lot, but think of it this way: When people like you step up by the thousands to chip in to this campaign, it means we have the resources to fend off relentless GOP attacks and run an aggressive, successful campaign.
**And truth be told, because Mitch McConnell only needs to flip one seat, we can 't afford for a single supporter to stay on the sidelines right now.**
This past week, we saw the consequences of a Republican-controlled Senate before our very eyes. A Supreme Court stacked with Mitch McConnell's and Donald Trump's justices cleared the way for more concealed weapons in public spaces. The next day, they overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , eviscerating the fundamental civil and human rights of women in America.
We cannot allow an increasingly radical GOP to capture another branch of our government and push their dangerous agenda on the American people. But right now, the Republican Senate campaign group has more than $45 million in the bank to make that happen.
As I have for years, I will go toe-to-toe with any right-wing Republican who's hell-bent on pushing an extremist, out-of-touch agenda on the American people. But it's going to take your $5, Friend, to make sure I can succeed. I'm up against a big, public FEC reporting deadline tonight - and it's your $5 that will show the strength of our grassroots campaign. It's your $5 that will enable me to fight, win, and protect Democratic Senate control.

Dick

subject: Elissa’s opponent: “No exceptions” on choice
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220630_3&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220630_3&amount=28]
Team,
With the Supreme Court’s recent decision to overturn Roe v. Wade, Michigan’s 1931 state law, based on a 1846 ban, is poised to snap back into effect, making abortion effectively illegal in our state. The law was temporarily blocked by a judge for now, but some of our hospitals have already stopped providing abortions in anticipation of a judge ending the temporary stay.
The 1931 law outlaws abortion for rape, incest, or pretty much any other reason. It also punishes women and doctors – both of which could be thrown in jail for up to 4 years for seeking or providing an abortion.
Elissa respects that people have differing, strong opinions on abortion, and that there are legitimate debates to be had over where the line is drawn. But for Elissa, this is a matter of personal freedom: her belief is that women should have the freedom to make this decision themselves. That women, in consultation with their doctors, should be trusted to draw the line – not the government.
On the other hand, Elissa’s opponent is vocally on the record as *completely* anti-choice. He frequently brags about his extreme views, explicitly saying he is ‘100% Pro-Life – No Exceptions.’
No exceptions. Even in cases of rape or incest. And even if the life of the mother is in immediate danger.
What’s more, in 2019 he led legislation to further codify felony charges for doctors who perform abortions, with a penalty of to up to two years in prison and a $50,000 fine. And, he’s made it clear that he’s not going to back down from these extreme views, stating ‘I’m not going to shy away from it because I know I’m right. And I take it very seriously.’
It's an extreme position even for a state on the cusp of criminalizing most abortions and it’s out of step with the vast majority of Michiganders.
This is one of the most competitive races in the country, and the contrast between Elissa and her opponent couldn’t be clearer on this issue. Elissa believes that women have different circumstances and should get a say in what happens to them and their health. Her opponent, who fashions himself a fighter for personal freedoms, seems to have no problem taking away the freedom to choose for all Michigan women. Now, more than ever, we must ensure that candidates are elected up and down the ballot that are willing to preserve this fundamental aspect of women’s freedom.

name: Donna F. Edwards
subject: Congratulations, Justice Jackson 🎉
body:
After 232 years and 115 Supreme Court Justices, Jackson is the first Black woman in history to hold this position. And she won’t be the last. Judge Jackson is an inspiration to Black girls and people everywhere — she reminds us all that the sky's the limit for what we can achieve.
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47211690/353474209/1108314527?refcode=em_logo&refcode2=2aaf054a-90f8-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NTE2MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYWFmMDU0YS05MGY4LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dc0BG7MWmPawD_8GiSqK5zf67_MgznvuPW1s817UJYw=)
---
**Ketanji Brown Jackson is the newest Supreme Court Justice of the United States!** I am _overjoyed_ for our women and girls, for our people, for our ancestors. In the words of Senator Cory Booker: “no one will steal [our] joy” from this moment. After 232 years and 115 Supreme Court Justices, **Jackson is the first Black woman in history to hold this position.** _And she won’t be the last._ Justice Jackson is an inspiration to Black girls and people everywhere — she reminds us all that the sky's the limit for what we can achieve. We are _incredibly_ lucky to have such a well-qualified and experienced justice on the Supreme Court. She brings the judicial, professional, and life experience we deserve. Our country will be better because of her. I am overjoyed for our women and girls, for our people, for our ancestors. In the words of Senator Cory Booker: “no one will steal [our] joy” from this moment. After 232 years and 115 Supreme Court Justices, Jackson is the first Black woman in history to hold this position. And she won’t be the last. Justice Jackson is an inspiration to Black girls and people everywhere — she reminds us all that the sky's the limit for what we can achieve. We are incredibly lucky to have such a well-qualified and experienced justice on the Supreme Court. She brings the judicial, professional, and life experience we deserve. We are lucky to be able to celebrate the freedoms with which we have been blessed – our freedom of speech, to exercise our religion, to keep and bear arms, to be free from unreasonable searches and seizure, and to the critically-important right of due process. This Independence Day is especially important following the victories we have had at the U.S. Supreme Court in the past week. We want to take a moment to thank each one of you for the support you have shown Harriet since she announced last September. She has put in more than 29,000 miles traveling the state to talk to voters and we know that you have put in many, many hours in support of the campaign. As early voting begins July 1, we want to be certain you know that we appreciate all of your efforts. For Wyoming, Team Hageman --- **Around Wyoming! ** Harriet continued covering the state this past week with a town hall in Buffalo, touring the WyoDak mine in Gillette, attending the Gillette Chamber Ice Cream Social, participating in a candidate forum in Sheridan, touring the Sunrise mine, and enjoying the Pie Social in Pine Bluffs. On Tuesday evening we held a tele town hall in which Harriet was able to speak to thousands of voters from across the state and answer the questions that are heavy on their minds. --- --- --- --- --- --- --- --- --- --- --- --- --- --- --- --- --- --- **Views From the Road ** We were lucky to have some beautiful views on the road this week, following a storm in Sheridan, and on the way to Cheynne from the Sunrise mine tour. Harriet’s brother Jim also shared a beautiful sunset and a spectacular sunrise that he captured near Old Fort Laramie. --- --- --- --- --- --- --- --- --- --- --- Voter Contact! We had volunteers knocking on doors in every single county this past June 29th – it truly was a “Super Saturday”!! Team Hageman will be knocking on doors in EVERY county this Saturday. Contact Kael at [kael@hagemanforwyoming.com](mailto:kael@hagemanforwyoming.com "kael@hagemanforwyoming.com") to join your neighbors to get out the vote for Harriet! Early voting begins in 8 days! --- **Volunteers on the trail! ** We have such amazing supporters across the state who are active in their community. clean_body: | | | | Welcome back to the “Weekly Wyoming Wrap Up.” We are looking forward to several days of celebrating our country’s independence! We are lucky to be able to celebrate the freedoms with which we have been blessed – our freedom of speech, to exercise our religion, to keep and bear arms, to be free from unreasonable searches and seizure, and to the critically-important right of due process. This Independence Day is especially important following the victories we have had at the U.S. Supreme Court in the past week. We want to take a moment to thank each one of you for the support you have shown Harriet since she announced last September. She has put in more than 29,000 miles traveling the state to talk to voters and we know that you have put in many, many hours in support of the campaign. As early voting begins July 1, we want to be certain you know that we appreciate all of your efforts. For Wyoming, Team Hageman Around Wyoming! Harriet continued covering the state this past week with a town hall in Buffalo, touring the WyoDak mine in Gillette, attending the Gillette Chamber Ice Cream Social, participating in a candidate forum in Sheridan, touring the Sunrise mine, and enjoying the Pie Social in Pine Bluffs. On Tuesday evening we held a tele town hall in which Harriet was able to speak to thousands of voters from across the state and answer the questions that are heavy on their minds. Views From the Road We were lucky to have some beautiful views on the road this week, following a storm in Sheridan, and on the way to Cheynne from the Sunrise mine tour. Harriet’s brother Jim also shared a beautiful sunset and a spectacular sunrise that he captured near Old Fort Laramie. Voter Contact! We had volunteers knocking on doors in every single county this past June 29th – it truly was a “Super Saturday”!! Team Hageman will be knocking on doors in EVERY county this Saturday. Contact Kael at mailto:kael@hagemanforwyoming.com "kael@hagemanforwyoming.com") to join your neighbors to get out the vote for Harriet! Early voting begins in 8 days! Volunteers on the trail! We have such amazing supporters across the state who are active in their community. We appreciate their work. In the News "Rep. body:
I have an urgent request on behalf of 50 young conservatives. Please help them. My name is Morton Blackwell, president of the L
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zl3qvj6rgdn3v54juaiv2n8fhkkcl5k2ih3813do_rp22sh2s8i66pb3clie2o31c1h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jmgr32t5nmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfas9lm9p38dthm1h30slgm5j38clmmap3fd75c9jjaodiclpbactn6dg6adr2csrt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coor1ddk61rm8phkcsqr0ptgmlin49fg)
I have an urgent request on behalf of 50 young conservatives. Please help them.
|
---
| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zgejmj0e2tfbjtgek99dlkbhu7rsrl8fdkptfdk0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3clie2o31c1h2bs) Fellow Conservative, I have an urgent request on behalf of 50 young conservatives. Please help them. My name is Morton Blackwell, president of the **Leadership Institute**. This organization is America’s premier training organization for conservatives. The Leadership Institute’s flagship training programs is coming up in a few days. This National Youth Leadership School provides the “bootcamp of politics” for young conservatives. Here, we help college students become the next generation of conservative leaders. **My staff just sent me an urgent email to let me know the demand to attend this special training greatly exceeded expectations.** More than 350 dedicated conservative students have applied to attend. This would be by far my largest Youth Leadership School ever. My staff secured the faculty resources and classroom space to meet the high demand. **But the rise in travel costs from inflation have exhausted the student scholarship funds.** The Leadership Institute provides scholarships to students to cover all travel and housing costs to attend this crucial training in Arlington, Virginia. As I see it, **financial burdens should never hold a young person back from learning to champion the principles that make America great. I hope you’ll agree with me on that.** The students applying for this program are some of the best and brightest young conservatives in America. They’re eager to spend their 4th of July weekend to learn to make a difference for their principles. These young people are the future leaders of our conservative movement and our country. I don’t want to have to turn a single one of them away because they can’t afford to travel here for their training. Here’s where you come in. **Will you make a special gift right now to make sure every young conservative who wants to can afford to attend this crucial training?** [**Yes, I'll give a special gift for the scholarship fund** ](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zeq7n6roduivtcbqevtnsmk8e3upkjkr92lvgvio_rp22sh2s8i66pb3clie2o31c1h2bs) Due to inflation, the total cost for a student scholarship has risen to $1,200 for travel and housing. That’s a significant amount for any one person to give, so I’m asking many other generous conservatives besides you. My goal today is to have 50 conservatives step up to give gifts of $25 each to cover the cost of one more student scholarship. **Will you give $25, or whatever your best gift may be, to help fund a student scholarship?** If so, please use this link to give online right away: [**https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/yls-scholarship**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zk1pqnj9cmdhthvcpc021v6gqah03m0a59dksu78_rp22sh2s8i66pb3clie2o31c1h2bs) Thank you for considering this urgent request to help young conservatives grow into the next generation of conservative leaders for America. Cordially, **Morton C. Blackwell**
President, Leadership Institute

As I see it, financial burdens should never hold a young person back from learning to champion the principles that make America great. I hope you’ll agree with me on that. The students applying for this program are some of the best and brightest young conservatives in America. They’re eager to spend their 4th of July weekend to learn to make a difference for their principles. These young people are the future leaders of our conservative movement and our country. I don’t want to have to turn a single one of them away because they can’t afford to travel here for their training. Here’s where you come in. Will you make a special gift right now to make sure every young conservative who wants to can afford to attend this crucial training? Due to inflation, the total cost for a student scholarship has risen to $1,200 for travel and housing. That’s a significant amount for any one person to give, so I’m asking many other generous conservatives besides you. My goal today is to have 50 conservatives step up to give gifts of $25 each to cover the cost of one more student scholarship. Will you give $25, or whatever your best gift may be, to help fund a student scholarship? If so, please use this link to give online right away: Thank you for considering this urgent request to help young conservatives grow into the next generation of conservative leaders for America. | Hey! Mariela Roca here. I'm running for Congress in Maryland's Sixth District. I'm a gun owner, proud mom, and combat veteran who served in Afghanistan. And I've never been more convinced we need strong, unwavering supporters of the second amendment in Congress, supporters like me.
Our freedoms are under attack from radical left-wing Democrats and squishy RINO Republicans. I literally kicked off my campaign at [The Machine Gun Nest](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001MkHqY5fYZY0AmMvZDunYBRsHTQjYT8pqQMF9u271RtO7dTdKLaD_sGHm4x80Lgm6dbB3GCqnaKAdsTEC_lFZlWskXMGgATDH_RGpQGKFoekXlDTfZZ17cYfIg-IlRbNdABn_cuQcPAnMGGjqHTHfZw==&c=2sY4_6DbUbCbDqQz0hJyeiaqe6y4TVOj96i1gA6e3mi8Avtpg5d0HA==&ch=ejlKSEBviCWpuig3BRsMJVyK3onHaRqCGZZHDT6k6S_gESj96IPAGw==) right here in Frederick because I know our right to keep and bear arms is the right that ensures all our others. Without it, we have nothing.
The battle over our sacred right to keep and bear arms never ends. Just last week, the Supreme Court rightly ruled in favor of New York's citizens, holding that they need not provide a government agency with a "good reason" to carry a weapon. But across the street, Congress passed a deeply disappointing "gun control" bill that won't stop tragedies but will stop law-abiding citizens from exercising their constitutional rights.
Behind the contrived talking points on safety, schools, and mental health, this is a radical gun control bill that many on the left hope will "pave the way" for more. As usual, it's chock full of ambiguities and overly broad language. As usual, no one who voted for it could conceivably have had the time to read it. Of course, our "representative", Total Whiner, far left sad trombone David Trone voted for it.
In Congress, I will support dedicated federal resources for school safety, mental health, and law enforcement. But I will never, ever vote to take away your freedom to keep and bear arms.
Other candidates in this race have stayed awfully silent on the issue of firearms. NOT ME. I do not back down from letting you know where I stand on the issues. And I never will.
Gun-grabbing, far-left David Trone has got to go. And this is the year we CAN WIN in Maryland's Sixth District since the Democrats' gerrymandered maps have been redrawn. Maryland is not hopeless! Soon, as a result of the Supreme Court's NY ruling, Maryland will have to change its overly onerous laws on carrying a firearm. And if WE win the primary, we'll have an opportunity to send a congresswoman from MARYLAND to the House who will fight tooth and nail for the second amendment and law-abiding gun owners every day. Imagine that, Marylanders!
BUT TO ACCOMPLISH THIS WE NEED YOUR SUPPORT.
I'm ready to take the fight to the gun-grabbers in Washington. I fought for our country in Afghanistan. I've fought for everything I have in my life, and I'm ready to FIGHT FOR YOU AND YOUR SECOND AMENDMENT RIGHTS IN CONGRESS.
[BUT GUESS WHAT? WE NEED MONEY, IT'S THAT SIMPLE. I CAN'T WIN THIS PRIMARY WITHOUT YOUR FINANCIAL SUPPORT. I CAN'T DEFEND THE CONSTITUTION UNLESS YOU STEP UP AND HELP ME!](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001MkHqY5fYZY0AmMvZDunYBRsHTQjYT8pqQMF9u271RtO7dTdKLaD_sPs1nngNfkNVlQrF2U85mW7UheLjeu6gxAUtRcD9RVaKXVsGmg-P_tZTxj5YUF-e-x2nvGxOlo9mzRffyEjn528fXSyq1XfD2hlvbDeD5I_BnAM1D6ZQVSMPDBPBOXrTZA==&c=2sY4_6DbUbCbDqQz0hJyeiaqe6y4TVOj96i1gA6e3mi8Avtpg5d0HA==&ch=ejlKSEBviCWpuig3BRsMJVyK3onHaRqCGZZHDT6k6S_gESj96IPAGw==)
I don't have daddy's lobbying money and beltway brunch connections. I can't buy this seat like others are trying to do. And I'm not trying to avoid the issues that matter. I want to represent Western Maryland and save the second amendment, not go to DC cocktail parties.
We need A BATTLE TESTED VET, A FIGHTER LIKE ME to take the fight to super woke, anti-gun David Trone. I put my life on the line to defend and uphold the constitution. I won't ever give in to those that want to take away our constitutional rights.
I am:
A proud mother of two, who was born and raised in Puerto Rico An Air Force combat veteran who served in Afghanistan A long-time gun owner (and a great shot too!) Someone who grew up poor and knows the value of hard work Unapologetically patriotic, with America-First values Ready to fight against far-left Democrats, compliant RINOS, and gun grabbers everywhere!

subject: Please help these young conservatives
body:
I have an urgent request on behalf of 50 young conservatives. Please help them.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zhla6bl1kcrumol5gamt4ike3po201j89u479aig_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk4qj4ttkumqn4s9nmorb79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4oni6eob0t776upr3dbn6kqn8dj36iq69p3469o74d3j65h33djnclhjcdjicarmeduie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6ccdgmmq30tr2coo79ddksuobapbi46h22sh2s8i66pb3clie4pj5cjh2bs)
I have an urgent request on behalf of 50 young conservatives. Please help them.
|
---
| | | [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zoe5qhc2o4orjgrdhvn1m38ne2ab0gbmq24spp48_rp22sh2s8i66pb3clie4pj5cjh2bs) Fellow Conservative, I have an urgent request on behalf of 50 young conservatives. Please help them. My name is Morton Blackwell, president of the **Leadership Institute**. This organization is America’s premier training organization for conservatives. The Leadership Institute’s flagship training programs is coming up in a few days. This National Youth Leadership School provides the “bootcamp of politics” for young conservatives. Here, we help college students become the next generation of conservative leaders. **My staff just sent me an urgent email to let me know the demand to attend this special training greatly exceeded expectations.** More than 350 dedicated conservative students have applied to attend. This would be by far my largest Youth Leadership School ever. My staff secured the faculty resources and classroom space to meet the high demand. **But the rise in travel costs from inflation have exhausted the student scholarship funds.** The Leadership Institute provides scholarships to students to cover all travel and housing costs to attend this crucial training in Arlington, Virginia. As I see it, **financial burdens should never hold a young person back from learning to champion the principles that make America great. I hope you’ll agree with me on that.** The students applying for this program are some of the best and brightest young conservatives in America. They’re eager to spend their 4th of July weekend to learn to make a difference for their principles. These young people are the future leaders of our conservative movement and our country. I don’t want to have to turn a single one of them away because they can’t afford to travel here for their training. Here’s where you come in. **Will you make a special gift right now to make sure every young conservative who wants to can afford to attend this crucial training?** [ **Yes, I'll give a special gift for the scholarship fund** ](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zk19ioicove70262eronprtbnqq22tgmmkpjk308_rp22sh2s8i66pb3clie4pj5cjh2bs) Due to inflation, the total cost for a student scholarship has risen to $1,200 for travel and housing. That’s a significant amount for any one person to give, so I’m asking many other generous conservatives besides you. My goal today is to have 50 conservatives step up to give gifts of $25 each to cover the cost of one more student scholarship. **Will you give $25, or whatever your best gift may be, to help fund a student scholarship?** If so, please use this link to give online right away: [**https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/yls-scholarship**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z06i9acjb9ffc94oc966df8u3q663rojonv4i3c8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3clie4pj5cjh2bs) Thank you for considering this urgent request to help young conservatives grow into the next generation of conservative leaders for America. Cordially, **Morton C. Blackwell**
President, Leadership Institute

body:
Peter,

We are so close, if we had 17 people from your area donate just $5, we would blow past our $16,076 goal instantly. Will you be the first person from your area to chip in?

DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lira-em-202206-eoq?refcode=em20220630am]

Today, as our country is more divided than ever, having donors from all over TX-23, across the state, and around the country gives us a chance to show the GOP exactly what this campaign is about — building a diverse people-powered coalition to fight for a better future in Texas and in our nation.

This race has never been about us, Peter.

It’s always been about the larger goals of turning this critical district Blue, keeping a Democratic majority in the house, and fighting to protect the lives, rights, and futures of Texas families.

If we’re going to have such a broad, far-reaching impact, we need supporters from all walks of life.

Bringing people together is nothing new for John. When he served in the military, and worked in the federal government, he built partnerships with people and communities across the country.

John knows just how important it is to show broad support, especially in such a competitive race. One way to do that is by receiving contributions from as many zip codes as possible.

Will you help us show that our campaign represents folks from all over? Just $5 will make all the difference when we have 17 people from your area all contributing!

[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lira-em-202206-eoq?refcode=em20220630am]

Let’s do this,
Team Lira

Friends, This November, Georgia is the Frontline – in the battle for life, parental rights, school choice, God’s Design, religious freedom, free market principles, and so much more. **That’s why Frontline Policy Action and Frontline Policy Council were founded – to lead the charge, defend our freedoms, advance our values, and win for families.** We’re holding the line, fighting back, and setting a big vision for a God-honoring Georgia. And that’s why we are holding the biggest event in Georgia politics and culture this fall – our United FRONTLINE Gala. **On September 9th, we are bringing in Mike Pompeo – arguably the greatest Secretary of State in modern history – and hosting Georgia conservative leaders to Unite our movement – United by Principles and United for Victory – ahead of this November.** [Tickets are currently discounted at $100. Buy your tickets TODAY for this MAJOR event!](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/434664?id=327745.183.1.a2825ecc75281b65e8541b20afb1d8aa) Frontline is proud to lead the charge for our state. We were proud to partner with Governor Kemp, Senator Unterman, and Representative Setzler for the strongest-in-the-nation pro-life law, and, as we enter a Post-Roe World, we will continue to fight for life until ALL life is cherished and protected. **Come hear our vision. Come mingle with your pro-family leaders across the state. Come fellowship with likeminded conservative, God-fearing Georgians. Come celebrate victories and a special evening. Come hear from Mike Pompeo!** [Get your tickets TODAY!](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/434664?id=327745.184.1.92bac154be3156060d8a51003c29ff88) We intend for this to be the biggest event of the year for all who care about our values and for the future of our state. Will you join us? Don’t miss out on this critical event! For Georgia,
Cole

Fellow American,

We disrupted the status quo and defied conventional wisdom when we won our election last year and I became Virginia’s first Black female Lieutenant Governor - and even more so that I did it as a Republican!

By doing so, I put a target on my back - particularly one that the radical Left has in their sights.

I launched Winsome PAC this quarter to continue building the conservative grassroots movement we started and to push forward in our fight to restore common sense leadership in Virginia and America.

But because I am now a target, I am under immense scrutiny. How Winsome PAC performs this first quarter will be watched and observed by allies and opponents alike, and it’s critical that we show we’re a force to be reckoned with.

We’ve set an ambitious fundraising goal for this first quarter, and as we approach tonight's deadline, we must make sure we’re on track to reach this goal.

Right now, we’re off the pace, and I need your help to ramp things up. [**As we approach our first End-of-Quarter deadline at MIDNIGHT TONIGHT, will you step up and chip in $10, $25, $50 or even $100 or more to help us get on track to hit our first quarterly target?**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63125%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=4%2bs9jC4FhFQmf1W3seowTQ&sysid=1)

I’m in this to help elect strong Republicans in Virginia and across the country and put an end to the radical Left’s divisive agenda in our schools, things I know are priorities of yours too.

body:
I am reaching out before our first official FEC deadline of the general election hits at midnight to personally ask for your financial support.
#

Hi there, I am reaching out before our first official FEC deadline of the general election hits at midnight to personally ask for your financial support.
We are throwing out the old, failed playbook and running the kind of grassroots campaign it takes to win in North Carolina.
It is a significant undertaking, but it is working. The polls show we’re tied with our opponent, and nonpartisan experts consistently rate this one of the seats “most likely to flip.”
We would not be in the strong position we are in today without the tens of thousands of small-dollar donors powering this campaign. But with the FEC deadline hours away, we need you to join them.

It takes an enormous amount of resources to run a campaign that can organize and speak to the hopes and needs of voters from the mountains to the coast, rural and urban alike.
Unfortunately, we know that we still have to raise more money because GOP super PACs are planning to dump at least $27 million more into this race on TV ads — on top of the $5 million they’ve already spent against me.
So if we want to flip this seat and expand our majority, then we have to hit our goal tonight. Right now, we’re still a bit short, and the only way to make sure we don’t fall short is by asking supporters like you.

name: Tom Fitton
subject: Help Us Clean Up Washington’s Corruption!
body:
Judicial Watch just announced a major victory for cleaner elections! We settled our federal lawsuit against North Carolina after the state removed over 430,000 ineligible names from its voter rolls!

| |
---
|
---
|
---
| Dear Fellow American,

I am asking you to stand with us today due to the historic importance of our work and because we need more support from committed conservatives like you!
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59279&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=)
---

For example, right now...

* We are putting the spotlight on and pulling back the curtain on Biden family corruption;

* We continue our national leadership fighting for honest elections by building on our series of historic and successful lawsuits that are cleaning up dirty voter registration rolls in **California** , **Indiana** , **Kentucky** , **North Carolina** and **Ohio** ...helping prevent voter fraud and protect the integrity of our elections in in 2022 and beyond. We're in court now in **Colorado** , **Illinois** , and **Pennsylvania** ...and we recently warned 14 counties in 5 more states we will sue if they don't begin to clean their voter rolls. And we overturned in court a partisan, gerrymandered congressional redistricting scheme in **Maryland**!

* We continue fighting in the courts _for_ **immigration law enforcement**. The open borders Biden administration is **overreaching its constitutional authority** ... _and has created an unprecedented surge of illegal aliens and a humanitarian and rule of law crisis at our southern border_.

* We recently won back-to-back court victories in **California** that overturned a state gender quota and a state "diversity" mandate for California corporate boards of directors.

Clearly, our need to police our elected and non-elected officials never ends.

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59279&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=)
---

For 28 years no one has worked harder or more effectively than Judicial Watch to challenge Washington's culture of corruption...no matter who controls Congress or the White House...and we can do this essential work because of the generous support we receive from you and hundreds of thousands of members. With strong member support we refuse to let corrupt politicians like Joe Biden off the hook!

And when politicians and bureaucrats fail to comply with our nation's open records laws or violate other statutes, we challenge them in the courts...

...and where others just talk and complain...Judicial Watch acts!

[But these battles are expensive.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59279&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=)

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59279&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=)
---

We are constantly confronted by government bureaucrats who "stonewall" our investigations. So, without the deep pockets of the government to fund our independent investigations, litigation and public education, _we rely on you and other members who share our commitment to upholding the rule of law_.

That's why I am counting on you to help us at this midpoint of the year with a special tax-deductible contribution today. [With your support our work can and often does literally change history.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59279&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=)

Thank you for all you do to help us fight for the rule of law!

Sincerely,

Tom Fitton
President

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59279&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=)

name: Bill de Blasio
subject: I LOVE this campaign
body:
No filter, no entourage. Just like how I started.
# [](https://act.billdeblasio.com/go/201?t=1&akid=174%2E39519%2EtzWXA0)

Friends -
I have LOVED campaigning for Congress so far. It’s like going back to my roots in nearly every sense.
Some mornings I am just hanging out outside of schools talking to parents.
Other days I’m out at a block party or a festival, just hanging out, talking to people. No filter, no entourage. Just like how I started.
I even collected petition signatures myself. It’s been thoroughly refreshing.
I am going to campaign hard, every single day. No one will work harder for the people of this district in D.C., and on this campaign.
Every day.
But some days are more important than others, and today is one of those days. That’s because our first FEC deadline of the race ends at midnight, and before it does, I have an important ask to make directly of you:
[**Can you please use this link to make a contribution — of any amount you can afford — to my campaign for Congress in New York’s new 10th Congressional District?**](https://act.billdeblasio.com/go/195?c0=join-bdb.JkhHxu&refcode=em-220630&t=2&akid=174%2E39519%2EtzWXA0)
The amount we raise isn’t nearly as important to me as the number of donations we receive. So please, contribute before midnight.
In solidarity,
Bill de Blasio

De Blasio for Congress
This email was sent to **dpwillis67@gmail.com**. If you need to, [**unsubscribe here**](https://act.billdeblasio.com/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=3&akid=174%2E39519%2EtzWXA0). We hope you'll stay, because emails are such an important part of how we organize.

Fellow American,

We disrupted the status quo and defied conventional wisdom when we won our election last year and I became Virginia’s first Black female Lieutenant Governor – and even more so that I did it as a Republican!

By doing so, I put a target on my back – particularly one that the radical Left has in their sights.

I launched Winsome PAC this quarter to continue building the conservative grassroots movement we started and to push forward in our fight to restore common sense leadership in Virginia and America.

But because I am now a target, I am under immense scrutiny. How Winsome PAC performs this first quarter will be watched and observed by allies and opponents alike, and it’s critical that we show we’re a force to be reckoned with.

We’ve set an ambitious fundraising goal for this first quarter, and as we approach tonight's deadline, we must make sure we’re on track to reach this goal.

subject: Your invitation: National Survey on Socialism
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.patriotmarketplace._BpfAnsh3ZIg1A)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York _magazine posed the question: "When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?" This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a "Great Reset" of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ -Hillsdale College's digest of liberty-author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as "'capitalism with Chinese characteristics'-a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below." Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for-and opposition to-socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://trk.patriotmarketplace._igxKg)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. ** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left's "long march through the institutions"-including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory-which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race-are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale's work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That's why I need your thoughts quickly. ** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism **in the next five days**, **your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, "Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy." If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember-**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

subject: $3 from Tim. $25 from Tina. $3 from you?
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alessandra Biaggi for Congress
body:
This is a big day for our campaign. Let's make it count.
#

Friends -
When we launched our campaign against Sean Patrick Maloney last month, we truly weren't sure what to expect.
Would the progressive movement's energy be with us right from the jump, or would things start off slow? Would we be able to raise the kind of money necessary to run a winning campaign against the corporate establishment and their deep pockets?
We didn't know for sure.
But then, just after Alessandra's announcement, Tim in Manhattan kicked us off with a $3 contribution, the first of our new race. Then came Tina in Peekskill with $25 more. And we were off...

| Hi , I wanted to send this to you today because it’s vitally important that we take this seriously.

Recently, Shore News Network released an article all about how California is making the food chain supply crisis worse.

[You can read that article here.](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=1e1704230b&e=f9133ea432)

We all know that the world is facing challenges when it comes to the food chain supply.

But California’s regulations coming straight from Gavin Newsom’s desk are directly causing food prices to skyrocket, putting companies out of business, and ultimately making your life incredibly more challenging and expensive in 2022.

Doesn’t it make sense that the Californian government should come to the aid of its residents in this time of crisis?

It seems that Gavin Newsom is doing quite the opposite.

So please, if you have a moment I need two things from you.

First -[ read this article and educate yourself on how California is making the supply chain crisis even worse. ](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=16eb792af5&e=f9133ea432)

Second - would you pass this email and message along to your friends and family?

There’s no reason why Californians should have to live like this.

I’m calling out Newsom for making Californians' lives incredibly difficult since he took office.

And I’m calling out Californians to stand up and vote for change and hope this November.

I believe we can have a better California.

\- Senator Brian Dahle

body:

Peter,
Women in Florida deserve the fundamental right to bodily autonomy. Women deserve the right to choose. And no one should be forced to carry a pregnancy against their will.
And with the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe v. Wade , it’s more important than EVER that we fight back against DeSantis and his anti-choice agenda.
If we all stand together, we can defeat DeSantis. We can elect a pro-choice Governor. And we can protect Florida women from the attack on our basic rights.
That’s why I’m asking you to give anything you can — whether it’s $1 or $100 — to help us reach our goal to raise $73,000 before midnight tomorrow and protect the rights women have had since 1973. Click here to chip in now. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-roe-73k?refcode=630email_1]

Fellow patriot,

Not too long ago, Hispanics were _expected_ and _assumed_ to be Democrats by anyone with a passive interest in political demography. In fact, **until recently, Hispanics were about as Democrat as suburbanites were Republican.**

I’m helping to change that narrative. I’m not a **“coconut”** - - brown on the outside, white on the inside - as some have called me. And I’m certainly not a **“self-hating Hispanic,”** as others have labeled me. My name is Monica De La Cruz, **a proud Hispanic Republican,** and I’m running for Congress in Texas’ 15th Congressional District to flip a seat RED which has never been held by a Republican in its HISTORY.

In 2020, I ran for the same seat in Congress I’m running for today. We ran one heck of a campaign and fell short by **_just_ 6,588 votes.** I didn’t get to the top of the hill in 2020, but I’m a fighter - I never give up. Peter, with all that's going on in our country right now, it's no wonder people are turning off the news and the divisive bickering on social media and retreating inward.

I can tell you that I’ve felt that urge also. It seems so much easier just to tune things out, doesn’t it? Now, more than ever, we’ve got to resist that temptation. We need to tune in and speak up.

**What helps me right now is remembering how lucky we are to live in America**. While there are brand new reasons to once again debate how big of a role government should have in our lives—a debate that will not end anytime soon—I take heart that we live in a democracy in which that spirited debate can take place. That encourages me today in a powerful way.

**I know that you also share my passion for free expression and debating ideas and that's why I'm so proud to have you on this team**.

I'm out there every week giving speeches, doing media interviews, hosting my podcast, communicating on social media and using every other tool at my disposal to share my beliefs with as many Americans as I can. **The reason is simple:** I want to inspire people to come together and build-up those things that unite us instead of spending time on the things that divide us.
