**In a year where there's been an explosion of mass shootings – more than 250 so far – last week the U.S. Supreme Court issued a ruling that will INCREASE the number of concealed weapons in public spaces. More guns on the street means more lives lost, friend. **
I lost my daughter, Jaime, in the Parkland shooting. Someone who never should have had a gun in the first place murdered Jaime and 16 others – and my Jaime wasn't the last. This month alone, dozens upon dozens of people – including more children – have died from gun violence. _What are our legislators doing_?

| When it comes to fighting for what’s most important to Arizonans, nobody in our U.S. Senate race can match my track record. I keep fighting, and I keep winning. I’ve battled Biden since his vice presidency and haven’t let up for a moment. Come November, Arizonans want a candidate who _will_ defeat Mark Kelly. I alone have the track record to take him on and show Arizonans a better alternative to the Washington status quo.

Inflation has devastated our state. In Phoenix, [inflation has soared 30% higher than the national average](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=c02fa6c7bb&e=6dcd2506d1). As Biden’s inflation crisis pounds Arizonans, it motivates weary voters to turn the page on the radical tax-and-spend agenda pushed by Mark Kelly, Chuck Schumer, and the Left.

In November, as voters choose between Mark Kelly and our Republican candidate, they will seek reassurance from a time-tested record of results. While Mark Kelly voted to increase the debt limit, I fought Biden in federal court over [his unconstitutional tax mandates](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=a60abb1aa6&e=6dcd2506d1). While Biden flippantly forgave college debt, I went to the source and challenged Arizona’s Board of Regents over [skyrocketing college tuition rates](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=d43d09c0fc&e=6dcd2506d1) and [sweetheart real estate deals](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=bb0ef93731&e=6dcd2506d1). Unfortunately, Washington is spending our lives away. Even though [I’ve recovered $1.5 billion](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=3870790a2b&e=6dcd2506d1) for Arizona consumers, that pales in comparison to what Mark Kelly spends in a single day in Washington.

The stakes remain high. Mark Kelly tries to hide his abysmal record and deep pockets under his charismatic character and a thick layer of smooth talk. Voters can no longer stomach the Biden administration, but at the end of the day they might choose an astronaut if they think he’s running against a conman. As a proven fighter and a principled conservative, only I can square off against Mark Kelly. My record will prove to Arizonans–and Americans!--that they really do have a better choice. My primary opponents have no record to stand on. For them to win, they’ll have to beat Mark Kelly at his own game. It won’t work and this means Republicans might fall short of reclaiming the Senate majority.

I understand what’s at stake, and I will fight Mark Kelly relentlessly.

Arizonans remain _extremely_ frustrated with the border crisis, so I’ll make sure Mark Kelly’s team has to contend with [a national leader on border security](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=c6141204cf&e=6dcd2506d1).

As conservative Arizonans reach to reclaim state and national majorities in order to continue to defend life, I’ll make Mark Kelly’s campaign suffer against [a proven pro-life champion](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=bdc0da2070&e=6dcd2506d1).

When the woke radical left campaigns for Mark Kelly as a progressive, I’ll show them what it’s like to brawl against a conservative candidate with a [winning record of fighting for religious freedom](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=807932169f&e=6dcd2506d1) who [leads](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=35ffd9d5db&e=6dcd2506d1) Arizona’s charge for [parents’ rights and school choice](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=a3beab1939&e=6dcd2506d1).

I’m fighting for our rights–and I alone have the record to prove that when I promise results, I deliver. Mark Kelly and the Democrats can’t weather a battle against the #BrnoBrigade. I hope you’ll join us in the fight for freedom, for safety, for values...all for the great state of Arizona.

| | | The right-wing extremists on the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade, destroying an essential protection for millions of women. The consequences of this decision will be deadly. In states across the country, cruel and deranged anti-abortion laws that have been previously blocked by courts are now in effect, or soon will be – some of which have NO exceptions for rape or incest. This news is horrifying. But our fight isn’t over – this isn't the final opinion or word on abortion access. We can’t let these extremist Supreme Court Justices turn back the clock on women’s rights. We must do everything we can to protect the right to a safe and legal abortion – and the only surefire way to do that is to codify Roe v. Wade into law. It’s time to raise our voices. [Sign now to demand Congress protect abortion rights and codify Roe v. Wade into law >>](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tda25290a-ce3a-4c32-8942-2532d2777930/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

name: Rashida Tlaib via Justice Democrats
subject: Billionaire bullies are seeking to defeat me
body:
Justice Democrats is a critical ally in our fight to expand progressive power in Congress by electing more working people and BIPOC candidates who have the lived experience of millions of marginalized people.
#
Peter,
The right-wing Supreme Court striking down abortion rights―which we have fought for and held dear for decades―was not about state’s rights. _If_ it was, this same Supreme Court would not have simultaneously struck down New York’s concealed carry gun law, which helped keep residents safe in public spaces such as grocery stores and subways.
When Mitch McConnell stole two Supreme Court seats―first by denying President Obama’s nominee in 2016, then by rushing through Trump’s nominee in 2020―Republicans fomented a far-right majority on the court with the goal of taking away our rights and implementing their anti-abortion, pro-gun, and pro-billionaire agenda.
They have succeeded. **But this fight is far from over.**
**We need to fight back through activism and elections.** Right now, we have Wall Street and cryto-billionaires attempting to replace progressive members of Congress with Wall Street Democrats and buying elections in swing districts and states.
Justice Democrats is a critical ally in our fight to expand progressive power in Congress by electing more working people and BIPOC candidates who have the lived experience of millions of marginalized people.
[Will you pitch in to support Justice Democrats and my re-election campaign with an end of month contribution today as we fight back against the billionaire bullies who are seeking to defeat me and progressives across the country?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110957?refcode=em20220630-24077&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=24077%2E1203867%2Epqi_I2)
**[Contribute](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110957?refcode=em20220630-24077&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=24077%2E1203867%2Epqi_I2)**
Because of re-districting, I’m running for re-election in a new district in Michigan. **And, a billionaire-funded super PAC has committed to spending at least $1 million in an attempt to defeat me.**
They’re threatened by my leadership on human rights and holding the rich and powerful accountable.
**Every dollar donated to my re-election campaign is going toward reaching voters in our new district** through door knocking, phone and text banking, community events, mailers, and TV, radio, and digital ads.
[Can you split a donation today between Justice Democrats and my re-election campaign to elect more progressives and to send me back to Congress to fight for you?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110957?refcode=em20220630-24077&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=24077%2E1203867%2Epqi_I2)
Thank you for having my back and for building our movement for the moment and the future.
In solidarity,
Rep. Rashida Tlaib

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank [here.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=23&akid=24077%2E1203867%2Epqi_I2) We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong. Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the [Centers for Disease Control](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=24&akid=24077%2E1203867%2Epqi_I2) and your state public health department.

Donald J. Trump June 29th, 2022
Endorsement of David Farnsworth
David Farnsworth is an outstanding individual who has shown great courage in representing the wonderful people of Arizona!

He has fought tirelessly on the 2020 Presidential Election Fraud Scandal, the open and poisonous Southern Border, for our totally under siege Second Amendment, our Military, our Vets, Tax and Regulation Cuts, and so many other things important to the people of the State that he so loves, and is a True Patriot, and has risked it all for his love of our Country and its Constitution.

David Farnsworth is going against a longtime political operative, or hack, Rusty Bowers, who has been an absolute disaster for Arizona and everything which Arizona Values represent. Bowers fought Election Integrity harder than any Democrat, or even the RINO Commissioners of Maricopa County. In fact, the RINOs of the State, headed by Bowers and his group, were far worse than the Democrats because you never knew where they were coming from. Bowers must be defeated, and highly respected David Farnsworth is the man to do it. He will straighten things out and secure your Border (just as we had, when I was President, the most secure Southern Border in the history of our Country, only two short years ago!).

This is a very important race because it will determine the future of Arizona, which is now on the precipice of disaster, with illegal aliens pouring in at every level and voters, through massive voter fraud and irregularities, losing their VOICE. David Farnsworth will get rid of the stench of Rusty Bowers and his crew of RINOs who are systematically destroying everything that Arizona stands for. | Friends, After the recent decision of the United States Supreme Court surrounding Roe v. Wade, it means that now is the time to stand up for what is right and codify protections for the unborn. I plan on co-sponsoring Senator Hackworth's “Protecting Virginia's Children Act", a bill to protect life at conception. Despite this promising news, the Virginia Senate still falls under Democrat control, so [I need all the help I can get](https://f1v3ff69.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fwww.brycereeves.com%2Fdonate/1/01000181b57eff2f-290cbf53-783b-4ba3-967e-0d6e7b58fc8d-000000/qaiR0C5qc2ogpELHrFc09nsTM98=276) to bring some common-sense back to the Senate and to our State. The gubernatorial election last year was a step in the right direction for our Commonwealth, but we need to bring the same kind of energy to the polls this November, the next, and beyond. The margin in the Senate is thin, with the Democrats holding a 21-19 majority. Even that tiny difference is enough for them to stack the committees in their favor and kill good legislation like my Constitutional Concealed Carry bill, and very well could jeopardize our mission to protect every Virginian life, born and unborn. Can I count on you to make a donation of [$100, $50, $25, or even $10 to further our cause?](https://f1v3ff69.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fwww.brycereeves.com%2Fdonate/2/01000181b57eff2f-290cbf53-783b-4ba3-967e-0d6e7b58fc8d-000000/dQE08K61CoEwFr5Aoxj2agznKd0=276) I am honored to be able to represent you as your Senator, and get the chance to pass legislation to help veterans (like the largest tax cut for veterans in Virginia history, which I was proud to pass just this year), our first responders, and every Virginian. I appreciate your dedication to our Commonwealth and to our Nation, and I want you to know that I couldn't do this without you.

**_DEADLINE ALERT_!**
**Midnight tonight is a critical fundraising deadline. Can you help?**

_WE NEED YOUR HELP TO FLIP THIS SEAT_!
_It’s no secret._ **The Congressional Majority** _and whether**Nancy Pelosi and Madeleine Dean** begin their long-awaited retirements _will be decided here in Pennsylvania _ and our race in Pennsylvania's 4th Congressional district._

**Nancy Pelosi and Madeleine Dean** have for too long supported policies that put our families out of work, keep our kids out of school, and make our gas and groceries completely unaffordable.

[_**ENOUGH IS ENOUGH! **_](https://cn4pa.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2d1d8e72981035507cd4628e7&id=ac890846e8&e=0a4d873a55)

With the red wave coming this November, _now is our chance to win this race and take back the House Majority_.

**Will you help by contributing $10, $25, $100, or whatever you can _RIGHT NOW_?** [](https://cn4pa.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2d1d8e72981035507cd4628e7&id=64edaf2760&e=0a4d873a55) If it feels like the late 70s all over again in America, that’s not by coincidence. _**Politicians like Madeleine Dean have created this mess, and now – after months of catastrophic polls – it’s clear they’ll do and say anything and everything to deny responsibility**_.

Now, inflation is devastating families, violent crime and drugs are sweeping through our cities, gas prices are crippling our economy, and a red army is once again violently trying to redraw Europe.

**What voters have deserved all along are real solutions to the tough problems we face – not big government socialism and woke mob values.**

**Unfortunately, that’s all that liberals like Dean have to offer.

_Please help us hit a big number tonight by sending in a donation RIGHT NOW_!** [](https://cn4pa.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2d1d8e72981035507cd4628e7&id=06624bc5b7&e=0a4d873a55)

For Pennsylvania,

Christian Nascimento

Hi Peter,
We need your support again. Not because we need help winning our November election, but because we need your help changing our state and country for the better this summer. Can you help us keep organizing by pitching in $7 before our midnight fundraising deadline? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/greg-casar-q2-2022?refcode=06.30_email]
You may already know, but our district, TX-35, is overwhelmingly Democratic. Traditionally, this is called a “safe” district. But our constituents in Texas are not safe from income inequality, racial injustice, draconian abortion bans, the climate crisis, and attacks on civil rights.
That is why Greg’s summer action plan is to use his general election campaign to protect Texans and organize for long term change. Greg has a fundraising deadline at midnight tonight. Peter,

We did it!

I am so grateful to everyone who came out to vote in Tuesday's primary -- and I want to say a huge thank you to all the people who called, sent texts, knocked doors, donated, and showed up to make our win possible.

We couldn't have done this without you -- and we need you even more for what's ahead.

But we know better.

body:
[1]Charles Booker

Hello, Peter,

The end of the quarter is quickly approaching (less than 12 hours
away!), and I need your help to remove Rand Paul from office. Kentucky
could be the bellwether state this year, and decide our Senate majority.

But right now, we’re up against a huge deadline for our campaign.
Tonight, we face a crucial end-of-quarter deadline, and we’re hoping to
raise $1,000,000 — an ambitious goal, but doable with the help of folks
like you.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220630.Kj9u9C&refcode=em20220630-2162&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=2162%2E346206%2EEZhFT0 ]Peter, can
you help us raise $1,000,000? Donate $5 — or whatever you
can give — today.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220630.Kj9u9C&refcode=em20220630-2162&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=2162%2E346206%2EEZhFT0 ]DONATE NOW →

To share my thanks, I’ll be calling folks who donate before midnight
tonight, June 30!

Peter,

So many Kentuckians are hungry for real change in our politics. We aren’t
deplorable. We aren’t the stereotypes or the insults. We are NOT Mitch
McConnell and Rand Paul.

The brokenness, exploitation, and abandonment we have faced doesn’t have
to be our future.

So while regular people have been ignored, mocked, dismissed, exploited,
robbed, and abandoned, that changes on November 8th, 2022. This victory
will be for US.

You may think my candidacy is a long shot. You might have a hard time
believing that big things are possible in Kentucky.

If you’re cynical, I don’t blame you. But I am telling you right now, the
people of Kentucky will prove every single doubter wrong.

With so much at stake, we can’t afford to fall short, which makes
deadlines like tonight’s end-of-quarter deadline so crucial. But if every
person reading this email donated just $5, we would not only reach our
goal, we would hit it out of the park.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220630.Kj9u9C&refcode=em20220630-2162&t=1003&akid=2162%2E346206%2EEZhFT0 ]Peter, we
can turn the tide this November, send Rand Paul packing, and build a
Senate Majority that will bring us the change we need, but the fight
starts now. Will you donate whatever you can today? Then, keep your phone
by with your ringer on — I may be giving you a call to share my gratitude!

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220630.Kj9u9C&refcode=em20220630-2162&t=1022&akid=2162%2E346206%2EEZhFT0 ]Contribute $5

We will win.

Together,

Charles

name: Steven Olikara
subject: Final five hours to get on the debate stage
body:
Dear Friends,

Thank you so much for supporting our campaign and helping us achieve many
incredible milestones. This month, we officially qualified to get on the
ballot for the U.S. Senate in Wisconsin, blowing past the 2,000 signature
requirement. We made history by elevating the first-ever Indian-American
U.S. Senate candidate in Wisconsin.

I need your help once again tonight: we have only one debate scheduled, and
the local TV station is trying to silence certain voices. They arbitrarily
set a requirement of 5,000 donors by June 30th to participate and notified
us of this nearly two weeks later than the establishment candidates. Of
course, there is nothing new about structural inequalities in our electoral
system. Our job is to overcome those systemic barriers. We will get on the
debate stage, and I'm excited to share that we are nearly at our goal.

To take us over the top, I'm asking each person receiving this email to
donate, or recruit one person to donate, at least $1 to our campaign by our
midnight deadline tonight. A big thanks to everyone who has already pitched
in and recruited friends to donate.

Here is the link to contribute: www.stevenolikara.com/debate
<http://secure.actblue.com/donate/olikara_debate?refcode=TeamOlikara>

Together, we will ensure our voice is represented on that debate stage and
show why we are the strongest to take on Ron Johnson in the fall. Thanks so
much for your help and support to renew our democracy.

With gratitude,

Steven

--
*Steven Olikara*
Olikara for U.S. Senate <https://www.stevenolikara.com/>
t: @StevenOlikara <http://www.twitter.com/StevenOlikara>

Hi Peter, it's Trudy. When I launched my campaign for Senate, I promised to lead with honesty. **So I'm going to be honest with you here: We're up against a lot this November.**
The GOP has countless deep-pocketed corporate donors and extremist megadonors. They have the power to obstruct meaningful legislation and spread misinformation about our democracy – and they won't hesitate to use it.
**They have truly powerful forces backing them – but what we have on our side is so much more important.** We have a real commitment to doing what's right. We have compassion, kindness, and integrity. We have someone with the heart of a nurse working to give all families a fair chance. We have united grassroots power. And we have history on our side.
I know that we have what it takes to win on Election Day – but only if we all stand together as one united team against extremism, hate, and greed. **That's why I'm emailing you today: We're still $4,284 short of our public FEC end-of-quarter grassroots goal, and our midnight deadline is in just a few hours at 11:59 p.m. tonight.** This deadline is very real, and if we fall short, everyone will know once our numbers become public.

Team,

Today I want to talk to you about who I am and what I stand for. I know your inbox has been bombarded with emails from my team explaining the importance and urgency of this election, but you need to hear from me about why I am the right candidate to replace Ron Kind and represent Wisconsin’s 3rd District.

I grew up in small-town Western Wisconsin on a dairy farm. Life on the farm wasn’t always easy, but it taught me the value of hard work, resilience, humility, and respect for my community. I have spent my professional career advocating and fighting for the people of rural Wisconsin, from working with Congressman Ron Kind and former Senator Herb Kohl on rural policy, Governor Evers’ Secretary of Agriculture to right now as a State Senator in Madison. When Ron Kind announced his retirement and asked me to fill his shoes, I knew it wouldn’t be easy- but I also knew it was something I needed to do to make sure we hold this seat..

I am running for Congress to fight for rural Wisconsin, expand access to quality and affordable health care, improve our infrastructure, advocate for our veterans, fight for women’s reproductive rights, and to protect our most vulnerable communities. _**My opponent could not be more wrong for our district. He lacks the character, the temperament, or the judgment to serve in Congress.**_ Our democracy is on the ballot in November - I’m running to protect it, while Derrick Van Orden is running to burn Washington to the ground.

I have spent my professional career advocating and fighting for the people of rural Wisconsin, from working with Congressman Ron Kind and former Senator Herb Kohl on rural policy, Governor Evers’ Secretary of Agriculture to right now as a State Senator in Madison. When Ron Kind announced his retirement and asked me to fill his shoes, I knew it wouldn’t be easy- but I also knew it was something I needed to do to make sure we hold this seat.. I am running for Congress to fight for rural Wisconsin, expand access to quality and affordable health care, improve our infrastructure, advocate for our veterans, fight for women’s reproductive rights, and to protect our most vulnerable communities. My opponent could not be more wrong for our district. He lacks the character, the temperament, or the judgment to serve in Congress. Did you see my email, Friend? I won't sugarcoat it: Mitch McConnell and the GOP have made me a target for defeat, and their campaign committee has more than $45 million at their disposal to flip this critical seat red. This is not a drill.
---
Grassroots supporters have been stepping up by the thousands to protect this seat and maintain Democratic Senate control - but unfortunately, I'm still $2,441 short of our must-hit goal, with only hours to go before our next public FEC deadline.
Falling short is not an option with Senate control on the line, so I'm counting on you to pitch in. **[So please, before it's too late, can you help me close our budget gap by donating $25 or more before midnight? Every dollar will go toward protecting this Democratic Senate seat and preventing Mitch McConnell from retaking Senate control.](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1212-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)**
Thanks for all you do,
Dick
\---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: **Richard Blumenthal**
Date: Thu, Jun 30, 2022
Subject: Your donation will protect Democratic control of the Senate

[ ](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=jareUxL%2BgjBUqV69BDQrmGAe90YP0%2BBW&url=http%3A%2F%2Frichardblumenthal.com%2F)
Friend,
$25.
If you donated that right now, it would make all the difference in our fight to keep this seat blue and protect Democratic control of the Senate.
I know one donation may not sound like a lot, but think of it this way: When people like you step up by the thousands to chip in to this campaign, it means we have the resources to fend off relentless GOP attacks and run an aggressive, successful campaign.
**And truth be told, because Mitch McConnell only needs to flip one seat, we can 't afford for a single supporter to stay on the sidelines right now.**
This past week, we saw the consequences of a Republican-controlled Senate before our very eyes. A Supreme Court stacked with Mitch McConnell's and Donald Trump's justices cleared the way for more concealed weapons in public spaces. The next day, they overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , eviscerating the fundamental civil and human rights of women in America.
We cannot allow an increasingly radical GOP to capture another branch of our government and push their dangerous agenda on the American people. But right now, the Republican Senate campaign group has more than $45 million in the bank to make that happen.
As I have for years, I will go toe-to-toe with any right-wing Republican who's hell-bent on pushing an extremist, out-of-touch agenda on the American people. But it's going to take your $25, Friend, to make sure I can succeed. I'm up against a big, public FEC reporting deadline tonight - and it's your $25 that will show the strength of our grassroots campaign. It's your $25 that will enable me to fight, win, and protect Democratic Senate control.
**[So please, before tonight's FEC deadline: Will you donate $25 or more to help me protect this seat and ensure we keep control of the Senate?](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1212-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)**
Thank you,
Dick

Team — Ashley here, I wanted to check in with you real quick. **As a woman and a veteran, the right to an abortion is not about politics for me, it's not a talking point — it's personal.** In the Army, I was stationed in Alabama, Texas, and Kansas. I didn’t get to choose where I lived. If I had been in uniform when _Roe_ was overturned, like my sisters-in-arms are now, I would have had little or no legal access to abortions. With more and more women in the U.S. military, the _Roe v. Wade_ overturning is a matter of national security. Our service members who fought for our freedoms overseas only to see them stripped away in their own country deserve better. Every politician who enabled the Supreme Court to turn the clock backward is responsible for endangering millions of Americans, and Brian Fitzpatrick is one of them. He failed to codify _Roe v. Wade_ when it mattered most, and Pennsylvanians are paying the price for it. disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Deluzio for Congress
body:
Hi Derek, I’ll keep this short.

I know you’ve heard from my team a lot this week, and I appreciate you sticking with us.

Derek, asking for money is probably my least favorite part of campaigning. But the truth is, we don’t have the same corporate donors or self-funding capability my opponent has. I’m proud to be funded by folks like you, but that means hitting every single fundraising goal is dependent on all of us working together.

Tonight is a big night for our campaign. After tonight, my team will turn over our fundraising report to the Federal Election Commission, and then everyone – including Kevin McCarthy and my opponent Jeremy Shaffer – will be able to see the strength of our grassroots movement. That’s why it’s so important to me that we put forward the strongest showing possible.

Derek, we only need to raise $565 more to hit our goal and end June on a strong note. If you’re able to chip in to help us close the gap, here’s a link just for you:

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/del-email-june2022?refcode=em_fr_2022.06.30_b2_cp_all&amount=15

Thanks again for sticking with us. Now, let’s go win this thing.

Chris

name: Jahana
subject: the good, the bad, and the ugly
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Jahana Hayes
body:
The campaign season has begun. The good, the bad, and the ugly of this time of year are on full display here in the Fifth District... My work in Washington has had a direct impact on my constituents in CT-05 – and THAT is what I’m campaigning on! We are ramping up our field organization to make sure I can communicate with voters directly and get the facts out.
The campaign season has begun. The good, the bad, and the ugly of this time of year are on full display here in the Fifth District...
The good – is always you, team. It has been so affirming to get back out in the community and meet you at meetings, celebrations and kick-off events. YOU are why I do the work.
The bad – Nonpartisan analysts at the Cook Political Report have downgraded this race, believing a Republican flip is more possible. If this seat flips, Democrats will lose the House Majority – and with it, our ability to make progress on women’s healthcare rights, gun violence prevention, and so much more.
The ugly – National right-wing groups and outside dark money donors are working harder than ever to unseat me in November. They are already spending millions and blanketing our district with misleading ads about me designed to stir up fear, distrust and confusion. The RNC opened their first-ever Connecticut office right here in this district and Republican leadership is playing a heavy hand in this race.
Here’s the truth: We’ve got so much great work to communicate out. I voted for the legislation people asked for. I voted to get COVID vaccines out into communities so we could begin to recover. I responded to the requests of everyone from hospitals to first responders and frontline workers who were saying they needed relief and needed it now. I voted for legislation like desperately needed small business relief.
Because that’s what good government does – good government is there to help when we need it. So that’s what I did: I listened, I responded and I delivered.
My work in Washington has had a direct impact on my constituents in CT-05 – and THAT is what I’m campaigning on! We are ramping up our field organization to make sure I can communicate with voters directly and get the facts out.
But I cannot do it all alone, friends. Will you consider making a donation to my re-election campaign before our big deadline at midnight tonight and join our fight for the Fifth?
Here’s the best link to use: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/JHCT-05-Email-June2022-FR-no?refcode=jahana](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47234338/353557732/891445062?refcode=E16685-20220630-EOQ4-SL-DeadlineEOM-PlainText-NA-NA&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODk4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZTdlZDBiZC1jNGY4LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mJdWC0CWWeigYlgCx4CzLVuyph0lym1EKHxl29gCwnE=)
It is all on the line. Thanks for being in the fight.
– Jahana

| | Dear Peter, Mental health matters – yet, in Oregon and across the globe, younger generations stare head-on into an uncertain, seemingly hopeless future wracked with inhospitable changes to the climate and increasingly threatening natural disasters. According to the Oregon Health Authority’s (OHA) **[recent study on the impacts of climate change on youth mental health,](https://click.everyaction.com/k/47234835/353559461/-1705082039?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjU3OTYyNTMxLWM3ZjgtZWMxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=9Th-rd81q4WjtvheYQjpX36kkaJ3p4358voYbndrT9Q=&emci=50a67e6f-a3f8-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=57962531-c7f8-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230)** today’s kids, teens, and young adults in Oregon feel: -Angry
-Doomed
-Powerless
-Overwhelmed
-Afraid
-Isolated
-Uncared for Our elected leaders need to know that youth mental health is suffering and climate change is a driving factor. [**Take action now by urging Gov. Brown, Sen. Wyden, Sen. Merkley, your U.S. representative, and your state lawmakers to read the report, and continue taking significant action on climate change to alleviate this crisis.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/47234836/353559462/-1125589346?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjU3OTYyNTMxLWM3ZjgtZWMxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=9Th-rd81q4WjtvheYQjpX36kkaJ3p4358voYbndrT9Q=&emci=50a67e6f-a3f8-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=57962531-c7f8-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) The sad and crucial reality is that our younger generations view climate change as a burden placed primarily on them. Ignored too often by those in power who refuse to take significant action on climate change, today’s kids feel kicked to the curb by politicians standing idly by as ecological catastrophes get worse and worse. **_This is why we need to make our voices heard to ensure our elected officials are aware of the relationship between climate change and youth mental health, and urge them to never stop working on climate solutions that protect our future._** [**Can you send a message to your elected leaders in Oregon about this study and the action they must take? **](https://click.everyaction.com/k/47234837/353559463/-1125589346?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjU3OTYyNTMxLWM3ZjgtZWMxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=9Th-rd81q4WjtvheYQjpX36kkaJ3p4358voYbndrT9Q=&emci=50a67e6f-a3f8-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=57962531-c7f8-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) OHA’s study also makes it clear that today’s youth know that in tackling the climate crisis, we must also address the crises of racism and environmental injustice interwoven with it. _“Climate change cannot be talked about without talking about settler colonialism, white supremacy, and... genocide,”_ especially considering that youth in Oregon’s Black, Indigenous, and people of color (BIPOC) and low-income communities will sustain the worst impacts to their lives, resources, and traditions. However, there is hope: with increased awareness of environmental issues, today’s younger generations are working tirelessly to organize, form coalitions, and implement creative and equitable solutions to tackle climate change. **We cannot let them fight this fight alone.** It is vital that we speak up in solidarity with these courageous young leaders of our future to empower them. We need to let politicians know how the state’s youth are feeling, and that it is their responsibility to take persistent action on climate change to build a better future in Oregon for us all. [**It takes less than a minute to send an email to those who represent you encouraging them to read OHA’s study and to keep pursuing meaningful climate action. **](https://click.everyaction.com/k/47234838/353559464/-1125589346?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjU3OTYyNTMxLWM3ZjgtZWMxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=9Th-rd81q4WjtvheYQjpX36kkaJ3p4358voYbndrT9Q=&emci=50a67e6f-a3f8-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=57962531-c7f8-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) Thank you,
Will Bertellotti, Communications Coordinator, OLCV |

#
Hey Derek, it’s Josh Shapiro and John Fetterman here.
All of our rights are on the line in this election — from access to abortion to a liveable minimum wage to the union way of life.
[**_That’s why we need you to get into the game and help us both win our big elections here in Pennsylvania. Tonight is our _first_ end-of-quarter fundraising deadline of the general election, so will you split a donation between our two campaigns right now?_**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/47858?refcode=em20220630-6373&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6373%2E434096%2EghGvtB)
Here’s why it’s so important that we all fight back:
_“Flipping our U.S. Senate seat is no easy task. But with another Democratic Senator (and strong Pennsylvania advocate), we can accomplish SO MUCH for this nation — on important issues like climate justice, health care, gun safety, and equality for all. I need you to help us build a grassroots campaign to fight for every vote in every one of Pennsylvania’s 67 counties.” — John_ __
_“The right to choose, free and fair elections, access to the ballot box, and so much more will be decided in this Governor’s race. I have always taken on the big fights, brought people together, and fought to keep Pennsylvanians from getting screwed — so I’ll be a Governor who every Pennsylvanian can count on. I need you on my team to make that happen.” — Josh_
[**_The stakes couldn’t be higher in Pennsylvania. Rush a split donation to our campaigns for Governor and U.S. Senate right now to support our campaigns and defend our rights:_**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/47858?refcode=em20220630-6373&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=6373%2E434096%2EghGvtB)
**[Contribute Now](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/47858?refcode=em20220630-6373&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=6373%2E434096%2EghGvtB)**
__
Thank you for joining our teams.
Onward,
Josh Shapiro + John Fetterman

It's been nearly one week since we learned the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_. It's been a devastating and difficult few days, but it has reminded me of one of the reasons I ran for Congress in the first place.

As a doctor, I have always believed that deeply personal reproductive decisions should be made by a patient, together with her doctor. And after years of watching male politicians with no medical experience presume that they could make these healthcare decisions for women, I got tired of it and decided to run for office myself.

I am proud of the work I've done in Congress to protect the rights of women to make their own reproductive healthcare decisions, including passing the Women's Health Protection Act last year to make _Roe_ the law of the land. So long as I am your representative, I will fight every effort to take away a woman’s right to choose – but I need your help to stay in Congress.

Election experts are calling the race for WA-08 a "toss-up," and I'm facing four anti-choice Republicans. If any of my extreme opponents are sent to Congress, they will likely support Kevin McCarthy's proposed national abortion ban. We can't put this most important, most personal healthcare decision into the hands of politicians.

I'm hoping to count on your support before tonight's FEC end-of-quarter fundraising deadline to ensure I have the resources to take on my anti-choice opponents and continue defending reproductive rights in Congress.

| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father's cabin, and did not return until he could "give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight."
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly-plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That's why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **"Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry." **
Through** "Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,"** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---

Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

| | Dear Peter, Friday’s announcement of the Supreme Court’s opinion in the _Dobbs_ case was a jurisprudential earthquake. While we had a chance to see it coming due to the previous leak of Alito’s draft opinion, the decision remains no less outrageous in restricting reproductive freedom and subjecting women, girls, trans and non-binary folks to forced pregnancies. In the days since then, the Supreme Court has also taken a hatchet to the First Amendment, breaking down the constitutional walls between church and state in two different cases. One invites religious practice in public institutions, including schools, while the other requires states that subsidize private education to include religious schools. As a member of a marginalized religious minority in the United States, I see the writing on the wall that these decisions portend. It brings me no joy to recall how much Democrats from San Francisco did to enable these decisions, while hypocritically mouthing concerns about the predictable results of their complicity. [**Can you stand with us to hold accountable complicit Democrats, and promote the checks and balances on the Court that I proposed over a decade ago?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTCxhAMhTRXK4t_BbI_sQ5MJPU1Bs8EE0eopf-YZ8fHuesgekWYlAk1kT2BnP-YgvxdnL0_XaQmyyR7TUdmZ6PzCd03x35HY49IwlMHm8U_1BLVjgWqC2cobl_oEA3Z3sr3Skbofl5qEGfE9pfLimx094JLuiM0-jhq8cdRcRc0YZMu7Y8eD8FDL_IptcyFGwVJHPXbTPyjn1qKDniZ6BWYO77hOiAijQtlAIR4R4uBdXRjwjuRdkpZ7p4AB-88Zd3L-wv2WgH8Tj_mtndSPgjq_5rH08OhsSCRdx0lBhhOAq/3nc/uzdWcDC1SL6bA9rFTBAq1w/h1/ojs_Sn8Ua3VXXNOoT6gONUqpoGGk4_8K0EwydDo4854) Nancy Pelosi has been the Speaker of the House during two different sessions of Congress. When she led the House a decade ago, Democrats also held the Senate, but she affirmatively chose not to codify _Roe v Wade_ , deferring to Obama’s decision to de-prioritize that campaign promise. While the House more recently did vote to codify _Roe_ , it did so only after the Senate was co-opted by the partisan gridlock that has made it a graveyard during the current session of Congress for everything from economic stimulus plans to proposals for worker rights, civil rights, voting rights, and more. Strap in—and hold accountable the Democrats who enabled it. | | | | | Dear Peter, Friday’s announcement of the Supreme Court’s opinion in the Dobbs case was a jurisprudential earthquake. One invites religious practice in public institutions, including schools, while the other requires states that subsidize private education to include religious schools. As a member of a marginalized religious minority in the United States, I see the writing on the wall that these decisions portend. It brings me no joy to recall how much Democrats from San Francisco did to enable these decisions, while hypocritically mouthing concerns about the predictable results of their complicity. Nancy Pelosi has been the Speaker of the House during two different sessions of Congress. When she led the House a decade ago, Democrats also held the Senate, but she affirmatively chose not to codify Roe v Wade , deferring to Obama’s decision to de-prioritize that campaign promise. body:
#
Peter,
Hitting our $235,000 end-of-quarter goal is about making sure we can keep doing the work of electing progressives and protecting our Democratic majority.
EIGHT people-first progressives that Pramila endorsed won their Democratic primaries this year! Delia Ramirez is the latest winner, after Democratic voters in Illinois lifted her to a huge victory. Delia joins seven other primary winners backed by Pramila this year, like Summer Lee and Michelle Vallejo, that won races where it was the people vs. corporate interests.
As we get closer to November, it’s critical that Pramila has the resources to win her own re-election, ensure these progressives win their general elections, AND help Democrats in swing districts defeat the GOP.
[**We have a lot of work to do before November — can you donate $3 to help Pramila reach our critical fundraising goal before midnight? We’re so close and every dollar counts.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/14495?refcode=em20220630-1386&t=1&akid=1386%2E420207%2En3Libc)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/14495?refcode=em20220630-1386&t=20&akid=1386%2E420207%2En3Libc)**
We’re so close to our goal! And with folks donating an average of $26 dollars this quarter, we can hit our goal in no time if even just 1 out of every 18 people reading this email donated before midnight.
We’re up against a lot: Pramila has two Republican challengers in her own race, and Democrats in swing districts will face extremely tough matchups in a difficult midterm year. We have a lot of Democrats to lift up, organizing to get done, and momentum to build so we can re-elect Pramila, protect our majorities, and elect people-first progressives.
In order to do the work we’ve planned, we need to hit our end-of-quarter goal. [**So, we have to ask, Peter: can you chip in $3 or more right now to help us finish the quarter strong and fund our critical electoral work this summer?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/14495?refcode=em20220630-1386&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=1386%2E420207%2En3Libc)

Team Jayapal

clean_body: We must fight like hell. | Friend, The Supreme Court just announced a shocking decision that attacks the EPA, undermines the bipartisan Clean Air Act, and sets a dangerous precedent that could severely inhibit the federal government’s ability to act in the public interest. The Clean Air Act really matters. It has allowed the EPA to prevent mass pollution and provided an important tool to protect Black, Brown, Indigenous, and frontline communities that bear the worst impacts of pollution and climate change. We need a nationwide grassroots mobilization to fight back. | This decision is only possible because of GOP operatives' decades-long scheme to pack the Supreme Court with illegitimate extremists and weaken the federal agencies that keep us safe—all to line the pockets of Big Polluters. The supposedly nonpartisan court is just pushing through what past Republican Congresses have tried and failed to pass. This isn't some abstract legal decision. These limits to the Clean Air Act mean more emergency room visits, more respiratory illnesses, and more early, preventable deaths. This dirtier air will hit our children, our grandparents, and our frontline communities first and worst. It also means more climate-fueled disasters. The good news (even though it's hard to see right now) is that Congress still has the power to do what the Court will not, which is why we're calling on them to swiftly pass a reconciliation bill that makes major investments in clean energy and environmental justice. It's a move that would rapidly accelerate a just transition to a clean energy future and help protect the climate for our families and communities—in spite of the Court's obstruction. We're not done here—with your help, we're going to continue to demand that our agencies and elected officials do what it takes to ensure a safe climate for all Americans. Thank you for your help. Onward, Jamal Raad Executive Director, Evergreen Action

I want to be direct. An extremist minority is imposing their unpopular views on the rest of America. But they don’t get the final word. There are ways we can fight back — and we must. I have a plan on how we can restore our democracy so that a small group of right-wing radicals can no longer drown out the will of the people.
* Expand the Supreme Court to rebalance it.
* End the filibuster to codify Roe.
* Fix the Electoral College so popular-vote losers like Donald Trump can’t stack the courts again. Remember: Five justices who ended the right to abortion were appointed by presidents who lost the popular vote.

**There are real solutions to the root cause of this crisis but it’s going to take big ideas — and big, structural changes. ** [_**I’m going to continue dreaming big and fighting hard — but I can’t do this alone. Peter,

Up until just recently, Hispanics were expected and assumed to be Democrats by anyone with a passive interest in political demography. In fact, until recently, Hispanics were about as Democrat as suburbanites were Republican.

I’m helping to change that narrative. I’m not a “coconut” - brown on the outside, white on the inside - as some have called me. And I’m certainly not a “**self-hating Hispanic** ,” as others have labeled me. My name is Monica De La Cruz, a proud Hispanic Republican, and I’m running for Congress in Texas’ 15th Congressional District to flip a seat RED which has never been held by a Republican in its **HISTORY**.

**HERE IS WHY I'M EMAILING YOU TODAY.**

**First:** Two weeks ago, my friend Mayra Flores made history by flipping a South Texas U.S. House seat Republican for the first time, sending a loud message to the entire political class in Washington that as suspected, Hispanic voters are leaving the Democrat Party in DROVES.

**Then:** _Politico_ called my race “**central** ” to Republican’s efforts to flip the House. If you recall, the district I’m running to represent in Congress has **NEVER elected a Republican** to serve our interests in Washington. Democrats have a 100% winning streak dating back to **1903**. ** **

**Now:** I officially have an opponent. After waiting more than a year to find out who my general election opponent is going to be, I’m writing to tell you that I’ll be facing off against Michelle Vallejo. She’s a far-left Democrat and she just won her primary by a mere 35 votes.

To be frank, that’s almost incomprehensible. **35 votes**. I’m trying to let that sink in. I could easily fit **35** people into my home for an open house. **35** people have been at my campaign headquarters making phone calls and strategizing how to win this pivotal Congressional race.

We have to hit this goal to go head-to-head with JD and his billionaire backers. [ ]Can you chip in $25 to make a strong showing when our numbers go public? [ ]Chip in $25 [ ]Other Amount $300,000 is a lot of money, but every single dollar is necessary if we’re going to flip this open Senate seat—here’s why: We’re going to talk to absolutely everyone we can. We need to knock on doors and make calls to reach as many voters as possible to talk to them about why I’m the right choice for Ohio. We’re going to film and run TV ads. Our pollster warned us the only way to win this race is to get our message in front of all voters, all the time. I’m going to spend every minute I can on the road, listening to voters, and meeting folks where they’re at. We’re going to do all this—and a heck of a lot more—to secure and expand our Democratic Senate majority. I’m giving this thing my absolute all through Election Day. [ ]Can I count on you to chip in to my campaign before midnight to help us hit our End-of-Quarter goal? clean_body: | | | Help us fight back | | | Team, Late yesterday, Attorney General Brnovich ruled that a 1901 law banning abortion, including no exceptions for rape or incest and mandatory jail time for medical providers, was now in effect in Arizona. This is a pathetic abuse of power by someone who is desperate to save a failing campaign. By trying to save his own political ambitions, Brnovich is implementing an extreme law that the overwhelming majority of Arizonans do not support. I promise you, we’re not going to just accept this pathetic ploy. We’re going to be working with partners as they explore all possible strategies. This is exactly what extremist Republicans have been counting on since the Roe reversal — legal chaos and confusion — while lives hang in the balance. It’s why they immediately celebrated Brnovich’s decision to try and implement a pre-statehood law that would imprison medical professionals providing care and Arizonans seeking it. The frontrunners for the AZ GOP nomination for governor and attorney general all signaled they supported Brnovich’s move and would follow in his footsteps. It’s clear if we want to protect Arizonans, we have to elect pro-choice Democrats who will work to reverse these terrible decisions and laws. AZ Dems up and down the ballot stand ready to protect mothers, families, doctors, and medical professionals because no one should be thrown in jail for providing or receiving essential medical care. name: Mark Kelly
subject: What comes next
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
The Supreme Court just struck down the right to safe and legal abortion.
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/16096?t=6&akid=3525%2E878179%2EjSGZDh) Friends --

The Supreme Court has struck down the right to safe and legal abortion, and the protections that generations of Americans were born with are gone. It's an enormous step back for our country.

In Arizona, Trump just endorsed one of my opponents who wants to go even further and pass a national ban on abortion in all cases -- no exceptions. He even opposes the decision that made birth control legal in this country.

The stakes were high before. But after this decision, it's more critical than ever that we win this race, because the Senate is the final defense against abortion being banned in the United States.

As long as I'm in the Senate, I'll work to make sure that never happens.

Which is why I have to ask: [**Will you split a donation between our people-powered campaign and Voter Protection Project today? We can 't let extremists take back this seat and eliminate the right to choose for millions of Americans.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/16096?t=7&akid=3525%2E878179%2EjSGZDh) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation to Mark Kelly and Voter Protection Project will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $5 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/16097?t=8&akid=3525%2E878179%2EjSGZDh)

Thank you for your support today and always,

body:
Winning the most competitive U.S. Senate race in the country will not be easy.
#

Friends —
We all know winning the most competitive U.S. Senate race in the country won’t be easy. There’s a lot of travel, events, time spent on the phone and on video calls — time away from your family.
You have to face millions and millions of dollars in ads attacking you personally.
You have to watch the former president hold multiple rallies in your state where he goes on extended rants about you, trying to convince his supporters you are some kind of terrible person.
And you have to hope that hundreds of thousands of people you might never meet will join you, rallying behind you to help you fight back.
All for a race that will probably come down to a few thousand votes.
But that’s exactly why every single one of those donations matter. Because this could be the closest race in the country. And Mark does need your help — even if he can’t ask you directly and in person.

Hello Peter,
As a top supporter I wanted you to be among the first to know about my next fight.
To help defeat the radical indoctrination of our babies in schools all across this country, I've just signed on as National Spokesperson for 1776 Action.
There are so many local battles that must be won, but right now, there's a very dangerous bill in the U.S. Senate that all of us must work together to stop.
[I ask you to learn more by taking just a few minutes to watch the short video I just recorded for you, and join me in this fight by adding your name to the 1776 Pledge. ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001i4iQa62mfRBrZY1br0bQpTzGGgPda9YfGsumFEGCqtyIjfj7d559ziqmhZAKovx3tUTJrbzMHIrV1TRfTwAqH1XLca3TjUAvt1RBGET528M49-UQP5o86W5cjEI6koEaFgAtAZahy_guxnHRJJYFkH0IVbNa7Hb4MS2jqd0rkNekQnSOehJGRrpnKSPTBtiE&c=G8BsH8ypIJxPqmUSgaW3LxbHnm0cBMAjhmJrzmHtptwELlAUU8rAIg==&ch=A0j6ApBkd7iRFj6oUOPUZKJdKY5KZ18_cCsJrICUHl-6HW6IIERtPw==)

Melanie has always been on the front lines of the fight to protect abortion, and today she joined thousands of other activists who stepped into their collective power to protest the right-wing Supreme Court’s cruel and capricious decision to strip us of our bodily autonomy and our right to privacy.
Thousands were and still are being arrested in Washington _but the reality is they will be let go after a couple of hours — **but for millions of people in states where abortion is now criminalized, their arrests will be far longer and far more severe.**_

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/88751/images/MKLogo.png]
It's Dr. Matt here and I want you to know something personal on the last day of Pride month. I am proud to now officially share the last name "Kenyatta."

As a chosen name that Malcolm's brilliant grandfather and grandmother adopted when they became involved in the Civil Rights movement nearly 40 years ago, the name "Kenyatta" was inspired by the African independence work happening in the 1960s.

To me, Malcolm's last name is a symbol of liberation. To me, the name was a poetic gift from my best friend and his ancestors as we chose to get married back in February. After getting my letter confirming the name change, I told Malcolm, "This feels badass."

Like you, the gutting of Roe vs. Wade last week hit me in the stomach. It was fundamental to so many other basic guarantees built upon it over the past 50+ years. This legal backsliding is an unjust reminder that our country's ruling minority sees progress for all genders as a threat to an old norm, one that no longer reflects American values.

While I should be celebrating my name change, I must now consider this surreal context happening during Pride Month. My right to love and control my own personhood is also being jeopardized by the highest court in the land, radicalized by unelected extremists emboldened to continue to strip away the fibers of our freedoms.

Living in my truth is a protest. But we have to confront the liars who swore to voters via their elected officials from both parties to respect the sacred, settled legal precedents that protect my freedom, like Roe vs. Wade .
How you ask? By raising our voices. We must elect more people right here at home in Pennsylvania who share our voice, who understand what is at stake for the least of us. We must elect Josh Shapiro as the next governor and John Fetterman the as next US Senator from Pennsylvania.

Don’t get me wrong, I love having Malcolm at home, but by chipping in $5, you can help keep him out on the trail (and out of my hair) raising his voice for Democrats up and down the ballot in PA. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mkweb]

Will you join us?

Best,

Dr. Matt Kenyatta

Philadelphia, PA 19107

| | There’s no doubt that we have a lot at stake in 2022 — not just here in Georgia, but across the country. It’s clear that the institutions that we look to to represent the people have failed us — and that’s by design. But with the midterms this year, we have a chance to change the way our democracy is run — and who it works for. We do not believe that all of the answers to the current moment lie in voting. But the truth is that if we give up and don’t vote, we’re abandoning a very important avenue to make change — and we abandon communities who are directly impacted by the decisions their representatives make. Pure and simple, elections have consequences, and we must vote accordingly. In 2020, we saw candidates running on platforms of trying to restrict access to the ballot and election denial, some of whom won their respective races. The impact of the choices some voters made then is evident now, as voters face needless obstacles to accessing the ballot box. Across the country, promoters of Trump’s Big Lie and conspiracy theorists are vying for positions from the top of the ticket all the way down the ballot. In states like Michigan, Wisconsin, and Pennsylvania, the people who sought to overturn election results and backed policies that suppress Black and brown voters are now running for office themselves, looking to make decisions on election outcomes. As we enter the next phase of the 2022 midterms — with reproductive freedom, gun safety, and voting rights all on the ballot, Fair Fight is laser-focused on protecting the right to vote and dismantling the systemic voter suppression that is rooted in our election processes. We’re working from the ground-up to break down barriers to civic participation and create a truly representative democracy. [_**But, we rely on your support to do this critical work. BIG DIFFERENCE.

name: Cheri Beasley
subject: I will not accept a future where our children have fewer rights.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Gillibrand for Senate
body:
Friends -
I had a few minutes of free time in my schedule this evening — which is a blessing these days as we sprint toward Election Day. But I wanted to reach out to you to share some reflections and a bit about why I am running for the United States Senate.
Running for office was not something I’d ever imagined I’d do when I graduated from law school. I had never seen an African American woman sit behind the bench until I was a practicing lawyer.
But it’s a moment that changed what I saw as possible, and I went on to run for judge myself. When my first opponent said I couldn’t win because I was a mom, I beat him by 30 points. Ultimately, I went on to win two statewide races and become the first African American woman to serve as Chief Justice of North Carolina.
Now, as I watch Washington fail our families while a politicized, right-wing majority of the Supreme Court rolls back our Constitutional rights, I feel the urgent call to serve the people of North Carolina once again. My promise from the start of this campaign for U.S. Senate has been that I would pursue justice with a relentless refusal to see it abandoned.
Republicans can try to bully me just like my first opponent. Their super PACs can keep spending millions on false attack ads against me, like they’ve already done. But I refuse to back down. I will not accept a future where our children have fewer rights than we did. We cannot go backward.
So I’m running this race to be a voice for people just like you, and if you help me win, I will cast the decisive 51st vote for progress — on abortion rights, voting rights, climate action and more.
North Carolina has been rated by experts as one of only three likely pick-up opportunities for Democrats. But the truth is I simply cannot do this alone.
So I’m humbly asking you to split a $10 contribution to our campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand today to help us flip this seat and expand our Senate majority. clean_body: Friends - I had a few minutes of free time in my schedule this evening — which is a blessing these days as we sprint toward Election Day. But I wanted to reach out to you to share some reflections and a bit about why I am running for the United States Senate. Running for office was not something I’d ever imagined I’d do when I graduated from law school. I had never seen an African American woman sit behind the bench until I was a practicing lawyer. But it’s a moment that changed what I saw as possible, and I went on to run for judge myself. When my first opponent said I couldn’t win because I was a mom, I beat him by 30 points. Ultimately, I went on to win two statewide races and become the first African American woman to serve as Chief Justice of North Carolina. Now, as I watch Washington fail our families while a politicized, right-wing majority of the Supreme Court rolls back our Constitutional rights, I feel the urgent call to serve the people of North Carolina once again. My promise from the start of this campaign for U.S. Senate has been that I would pursue justice with a relentless refusal to see it abandoned. Republicans can try to bully me just like my first opponent. Their super PACs can keep spending millions on false attack ads against me, like they’ve already done. But I refuse to back down. I will not accept a future where our children have fewer rights than we did. We cannot go backward. So I’m running this race to be a voice for people just like you, and if you help me win, I will cast the decisive 51st vote for progress — on abortion rights, voting rights, climate action and more. North Carolina has been rated by experts as one of only three likely pick-up opportunities for Democrats. But the truth is I simply cannot do this alone. So I’m humbly asking you to split a $10 contribution to our campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand today to help us flip this seat and expand our Senate majority. The FEC deadline is almost here, and it is critical that we reach our goal and raise the resources necessary to compete with the super PACs trying to buy this seat. name: Gavin Newsom for Governor
subject: This is a Big F*cking Deal, to steal a phrase
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY NEWSOM FOR CALIFORNIA – GOVERNOR – 2022
body:
Earlier this week, Governor Newsom signed a budget agreement that includes a number of critical items you need to know about:

Friends -
Earlier this week, Governor Newsom signed a budget agreement that includes a number of critical items you need to know about:
**1.** California is making direct payments of up to $1,050 to twenty-three million Californians. You can use it to help cover gas costs, food — whatever you need. This is the largest direct payment to people of any state in the country.
**2.** California will become the first state to achieve universal access to health care coverage for EVERYONE, including every undocumented immigrant in the state. It’s not only the right and moral thing to do, but if COVID has taught us anything it’s that the health of one, impacts the health of all.
To steal a phrase, this is a Big F*cking Deal.
**3.** $200 million in additional funding for reproductive health care services and tax credits for businesses that leave anti-choice states and come to California.
**4.** Money to accelerate our clean energy future, respond to severe wildfires, extreme heat, and drought as well as money for additional power-generating capacity.
**5.** Programs for homeownership, education funding, universal preschool, children’s mental health and free school meals.
And we’re going to have more big news soon.
Stay tuned.
Gavin Newsom for Governor
* * *
**Today is a fundraising deadline for Gavin Newsom’s re-election campaign. If you could chip in $5, $10 or whatever you can afford before it ends at midnight, it would mean a lot. Thank you.**

body:
One bad decision after another
|
---

Friend,

It has been a very difficult few weeks. We have seen one bad decision after another come from the Supreme Court. So I wanted to give you an update on the impact recent decisions from the United States Supreme Court will have on our nation:

➔ Just today, the Supreme Court has announced it will consider a case that could give state legislatures sole control over our right to free and fair elections.

➔ Earlier this year, SCOTUS allowed the use of an unfair map that packs Black Alabama voters into a single congressional district and robs them of the opportunity to elect a representative of their choice in TWO districts. The court will not be issuing a final decision until after this year’s election which means Alabamians will have to vote on unconstitutional maps this fall.

➔ Earlier this week, the Supreme Court put a hold on a district court’s decision to block the use of Louisiana’s congressional map that violates Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act. This delay is forcing Louisianans to vote on unfair maps just like their neighbors in Alabama.

**All On The Line and fair map advocates are committed to keep fighting for fair maps in and outside of court.[ Chip in a few bucks towards our June end-of-month goal to help us keep going. When I ran for office, the South Carolina legislature was dominated by a Good Old Boys' Club and my opponent thought women shouldn’t be in politics. People thought I was too brown, too female, too young, too conservative, too principled. I said: Too bad. I was inspired by great women who broke barriers and defied expectations, women like Margaret Thatcher and Jeane Kirkpatrick. That’s why I wrote this book. "If You Want Something Done..." is set to be released on October 4. subject: If you only read one email from me this week — it should be this.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by The Fairness Project
body:
Team — we’re fed up. Fed up with SCOTUS stripping us of our freedoms — giving guns more rights than people with uteruses. Fed up with Congress letting political games — on both sides of the aisle — get in the way of actionable change and putting our children in harm’s way. This is all to say, when it comes to Washington, we’re over it.

When you’re as passionate about progress as us, it can feel like you’re shouting and shouting for change, and no one in Washington is listening. Believe me — we get it.

But what I will say is: we have hope. Ballot measures really are our way to go around a broken system. When it feels like no one is listening, we are. We’re working in Vermont and Michigan to help voters pass permanent reproductive protections in each state. We’re working in South Dakota to give working people without health insurance the care they need by expanding Medicaid. We’re working with voters in Nebraska to raise wages to a livable standard, so working parents don’t need three jobs just to get by.

Believe me, team — we’re listening. And we’re winning. We’ve found the workaround that passes life-changing policy when Washington won’t act. We’ve done it 24 times over, and we’re ready to do it 7 more this November.

7 campaigns makes this our biggest slate ever. And finishing out this quarter strong is the only surefire way to power these campaigns into the thick of what may be the most critical midterm election of the decade.

Right now, we’re just $214 short of our $30,000 End-of-Quarter goal, friend. Peter,

Up until just recently, Hispanics were expected and assumed to be Democrats by anyone with a passive interest in political demography. In fact, until recently, Hispanics were about as Democrat as suburbanites were Republican.

I’m helping to change that narrative. I’m not a “coconut” - brown on the outside, white on the inside - as some have called me. And I’m certainly not a “**self-hating Hispanic** ,” as others have labeled me. My name is Monica De La Cruz, a proud Hispanic Republican, and I’m running for Congress in Texas’ 15th Congressional District to flip a seat RED which has never been held by a Republican in its **HISTORY**.

**HERE IS WHY I'M EMAILING YOU TODAY.**

**First:** Two weeks ago, my friend Mayra Flores made history by flipping a South Texas U.S. House seat Republican for the first time, sending a loud message to the entire political class in Washington that as suspected, Hispanic voters are leaving the Democrat Party in DROVES.

**Then:** _Politico_ called my race “**central** ” to Republican’s efforts to flip the House. If you recall, the district I’m running to represent in Congress has **NEVER elected a Republican** to serve our interests in Washington. Democrats have a 100% winning streak dating back to **1903**. ** **

**Now:** I officially have an opponent. After waiting more than a year to find out who my general election opponent is going to be, I’m writing to tell you that I’ll be facing off against Michelle Vallejo. She’s a far-left Democrat and she just won her primary by a mere 35 votes.

To be frank, that’s almost incomprehensible. **35 votes**. I’m trying to let that sink in. I could easily fit **35** people into my home for an open house. **35** people have been at my campaign headquarters making phone calls and strategizing how to win this pivotal Congressional race.

If you recall, the district I’m running to represent in Congress has NEVER elected a Republican to serve our interests in Washington. Democrats have a 100% winning streak dating back to 1903. Now: I officially have an opponent. After waiting more than a year to find out who my general election opponent is going to be, I’m writing to tell you that I’ll be facing off against Michelle Vallejo. She’s a far-left Democrat and she just won her primary by a mere 35 votes. To be frank, that’s almost incomprehensible. 35 votes. I’m trying to let that sink in. I could easily fit 35 people into my home for an open house. 35 people have been at my campaign headquarters making phone calls and strategizing how to win this pivotal Congressional race. I won’t lie to you – the general election race between me and Ms. Vallejo is going to be cutthroat. Can you imagine if the margin of victory in November in our race comes down to less than 100 votes? WITH my eye on November, I’m determined to flip this district RED for the first time in more than 100 years. Equally as determined are the Democrats who know that once they lose this seat, it’ll be gone for good. That’s why I’m coming to you today with an urge plea: I need 35 donors to chip in $10 or more by midnight tonight. I don’t want to take any chances of not having the money to win this race and help flip the House. The close nature of my own race in 2020 (I fell short 6,000 votes) and the 35 votes my opponent won by last week has me worried. South Texas is finished with the empty promises and failed leadership of the increasingly socialist Democrat Party. Thank you! Monica De La Cruz! Peter,

Up until just recently, Hispanics were expected and assumed to be Democrats by anyone with a passive interest in political demography. In fact, until recently, Hispanics were about as Democrat as suburbanites were Republican.

I’m helping to change that narrative. I’m not a “coconut” - brown on the outside, white on the inside - as some have called me. And I’m certainly not a “**self-hating Hispanic** ,” as others have labeled me. My name is Monica De La Cruz, a proud Hispanic Republican, and I’m running for Congress in Texas’ 15th Congressional District to flip a seat RED which has never been held by a Republican in its **HISTORY**.

**HERE IS WHY I'M EMAILING YOU TODAY.**

**First:** Two weeks ago, my friend Mayra Flores made history by flipping a South Texas U.S. House seat Republican for the first time, sending a loud message to the entire political class in Washington that as suspected, Hispanic voters are leaving the Democrat Party in DROVES.

**Then:** _Politico_ called my race “**central** ” to Republican’s efforts to flip the House. If you recall, the district I’m running to represent in Congress has **NEVER elected a Republican** to serve our interests in Washington. Democrats have a 100% winning streak dating back to **1903**. ** **

**Now:** I officially have an opponent. After waiting more than a year to find out who my general election opponent is going to be, I’m writing to tell you that I’ll be facing off against Michelle Vallejo. She’s a far-left Democrat and she just won her primary by a mere 35 votes.

| | **Friends,

****Thank you to everyone who helped this campaign. We shocked the political world three weeks ago because the voters clearly understood that our nation needs significant change in our political leadership. They knew that the status quo is unacceptable. Unfortunately, in the last three weeks that message was drowned out and overcome by the smears and misrepresentations of our opponents, funded by hundreds of thousands of dollars of outside-the-state money that we simply could not match.

But do not be discouraged! I certainly am not. Although we didn't win on Tuesday, we've put the Establishment in Mississippi on notice that the base will no longer tolerate moderate politics from Republicans in Washington. I'm confident that we have changed the course of politics in Mississippi, and for the better.

If anyone has ideas on how to harness the energy from this campaign to productively help our state in the future, please let me know.

It was a true pleasure working for, and with, all of you these last few months.

Sincerely,** **Michael** **P.S. I've always hated asking for money, but the campaign is still in a rather decent amount of debt, and any contributions would certainly help. This link is still active for anyone interested. [www.votecassidy.com/contribute](https://votecassidy.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd1ed16d660684d08d27f7e75&id=6b835e7a05&e=9c0f75db69).
