name: Alexandra Rojas
subject: Jessica, Kina, Marie
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

I’m going to speak plainly: I’m worried that if we don’t start raising a
lot more money, our incumbent Justice Democrats and our next primary
challengers could lose.

Let me explain.

On Tuesday night, Kina Collins — a young Black woman from the West Side of
Chicago — took on the Chicago political machine without a cent of
corporate PAC money. The Democratic establishment spent so much money on
the race, we just couldn’t overcome it. Pres. Biden and Speaker Pelosi
endorsed our opponent in order to stop Kina’s fight for Medicare for All,
a Green New Deal, and real investments in her communities.

Jessica Cisneros lost by just a few hundred votes to anti-abortion,
pro-NRA Henry Cuellar. Again, millions in corporate Super PAC money, Big
Oil, and private prison companies lined up against Jessica and Justice
Democrats, and we came up just short. Jessica’s race would’ve been
different if Pelosi hadn’t campaigned for an anti-abortion incumbent and
the establishment hadn’t spent millions to stop a progressive woman of
color.

If we had just a little more money, there’s a real chance we could have
lifted Kina and Jessica to victory. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110949?refcode=em20220630-24088&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=24088%2E1203867%2EGpfswf ]If we want to win more primary
challenges and protect the Squad while we’re up against millions in
corporate Super PAC spending and endorsements from Nancy Pelosi, we need
our grassroots supporters to step up. Can you donate $3
today to help us take on the political establishment and elect progressive
fighters to Congress?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110949?refcode=em20220630-24088&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=24088%2E1203867%2EGpfswf ]Contribute

It’s not just Kina and Jessica. On Tuesday, our first incumbent Justice
Democrat lost a primary. Democratic redistricting threw Marie Newman into
a difficult primary against another incumbent that had backing from much
of the Democratic establishment. After defeating a conservative,
anti-abortion Democratic incumbent in 2020 and fighting unapologetically
for the people in Congress, Marie came up short in her latest primary.

JD incumbents Cori Bush, Jamaal Bowman, and Rashida Tlaib still have
competitive primaries this year. And corporate Democrats and Republican
billionaires are spending millions to try to unseat our most outspoken
advocates in Congress. A corporate Super PAC has already announced it’s
spending $1 million against Rashida.

The establishment will do everything it can to defeat Justice Democrats.
The establishment will spend as much money as it can to defeat us. Big
money and the establishment stopped our movement from powering Kina,
Jessica, and Marie to victory, but we can’t keep letting this happen.

Nearly 90% of Congressional races are won by the candidate with more
money. We’ve won races with less money before, but we have to
significantly close the fundraising gap in our races — or we don’t have a
chance.

We’ve seen what can happen when we get outspent by corporate Super PACs
with access to unlimited funds. Now, we need to make sure we’re prepared
to protect the Squad in their primaries and build up our fundraising for
the future.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110949?refcode=em20220630-24088&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=24088%2E1203867%2EGpfswf ]Can you chip in $3 so we can run strong primaries
against the corporate-backed Democratic establishment? We’ve changed
politics in a big way since first helping elect AOC in 2018, but we need
your support to keep changing politics.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110949?refcode=em20220630-24088&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1024&akid=24088%2E1203867%2EGpfswf ]Contribute

I am so grateful to have your support. We run on donations from folks
giving $5, $27, $50 at a time — our average donation this year is $18.12.
And that’s how it should be, fueled by the people, not corporate PACs.

If just 1 out of every 10 people reading this email chipped in, it would
be a huge boost for us heading into important primaries for Cori, Jamaal,
and Rashida.

Thank you so much.

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas, Executive Director
Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1025&akid=24088%2E1203867%2EGpfswf ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1026&akid=24088%2E1203867%2EGpfswf ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20220630-24088-footer&t=1027&refcode2=24088_1203867_Gpfswf&akid=24088%2E1203867%2EGpfswf

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://go.justicedemocrats.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1028&akid=24088%2E1203867%2EGpfswf

PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS. Not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee.
JusticeDemocrats.com
10629 Hardin Valley Rd, #226
Knoxville, TN 37932
Email us: us@justicedemocrats.com

Join me in the fight to fix our country because these song lyrics are our current reality... | | |
---
| |
---
| Dear Kansan,

In the words of Hank Williams Jr., “interest is up and the stock market’s down and you only get mugged if you go downtown.” _**Friends, I’m calling on you to join me in the fight**** to fix our country because these song lyrics are our current reality. **_

We have a lot of work to do. Biden's self-inflicted inflation is wreaking havoc on small businesses all over America, particularly on farms where everything from fertilizer to fence is through the roof. We need to fix the supply chain, stop the big government socialist spending addiction, and curb inflation. We need to fund the police, restore law and order, secure our southern border, and protect the second amendment rights of law-abiding citizens. We need to advocate for pro-life provisions in the wake of the momentous decision by the Supreme Court to strike down Roe v. Wade.

**_The bottom line is that we need to take our country back. _**

I am in the process of working to see that Republicans fire Nancy Pelosi and the radical Left's socialist agenda this fall. Please support my efforts **_[HERE](https://traceymann.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60a16ea89a176679a5f31366c&id=af1f914d5d&e=a9d1410029)_** so we can stop this madness.

**_Will you join me in the fight to protect our children’s future?_**

Yours in the fight,

Tracey

P.S. I will continue to stand for Kansas as we move forward, and I will do everything in my power to ensure that our kids have a bright future. Please **_[(click here)](https://traceymann.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60a16ea89a176679a5f31366c&id=31ca6dce94&e=a9d1410029)_** to donate today and help take our country back

name: Rebecca Rodriguez
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
When the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade on Friday, Alexandria understood the importance of using our resources to meet the moment and provide support in whatever ways we could.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220630-3153-header&t=1&akid=3153%2E2526796%2EfnjLpV)
For the past several days, we’ve taken a necessary and urgent break from our planned campaign operations.
When the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ on Friday, Alexandria understood the importance of using our resources to meet the moment and provide support in whatever ways we could.
Within 48 hours, our movement came together to raise an incredible $465,234.87 for five abortion funds across the nation.
But that’s not all. Alexandria immediately took to Instagram Live to share electoral and policy priorities. She called on President Biden to open abortion clinics on federal lands, and we shared a petition pushing for support that over 33,000 of you signed. Then she took to Twitter to share a real action plan and next steps:
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220630.uCDnR5&refcode=em20220630-3153-P_FND_EOQ_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3153%2E2526796%2EfnjLpV)
Alexandria even shared how anyone can get abortion pills mailed to them in any of the 50 states. And whatever push back she received from Republicans, her response was simple:
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220630.uCDnR5&refcode=em20220630-3153-P_FND_EOQ_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=3153%2E2526796%2EfnjLpV)
**In order to make space for this work, we knew we would have to put fundraising for our campaign on the back burner. We did that because we understood the gravity of the moment.** So now, we need your help to close the gap on our end-of-quarter fundraising before our deadline at midnight tonight.
[With just hours left before our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline, will you chip in whatever you can today to help us report a strong fundraising quarter as we head toward our general election in 18 weeks?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220630.uCDnR5&refcode=em20220630-3153-P_FND_EOQ_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=3153%2E2526796%2EfnjLpV) _Our average contribution this month is $17._
**[Contribute $17](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220630.uCDnR5&refcode=em20220630-3153-P_FND_EOQ_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&akid=3153%2E2526796%2EfnjLpV)**
Every contribution allows our team to not only coordinate more large-scale efforts like these, but also allows Alexandria to stay focused on the work that matters and the work we elected her to do.
**Your contribution of any amount will make a huge impact on the work we’ll be able to take on in the coming months, and will help ensure Alexandria can continue to lead during these moments —** [please make a contribution right now to help keep Alexandria fighting for the better future our communities deserve.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220630.uCDnR5&refcode=em20220630-3153-P_FND_EOQ_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=24&akid=3153%2E2526796%2EfnjLpV)
Thank you,
Rebecca Rodriguez
Campaign Manager, Team AOC

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220630?refcode=em20220630-3153-P_FND_EOQ_GFM&t=25&refcode2=3153_2526796_fnjLpV&akid=3153%2E2526796%2EfnjLpV)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20220630-3153-P_FND_EOQ_GFM&t=26&akid=3153%2E2526796%2EfnjLpV)**

subject: Can you join me for a Zoom tonight?
body:

body: A technique the Left uses to increase control through public anxiety is to “set multiple fires along the ridgeline.” [Action] How the Militant Left Uses Fear [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59283&L=27597&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvaG93LXRoZS1taWxpdGFudC1sZWZ0LXVzZXMtZmVhci8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1hY3Rpb24rYWxlcnQmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==] >From _The European Conservative_: The objective of the militant political Left—whether in Hungary, at the European Union (EU), or in the United States—is to keep the public in a state of perpetual, acute, neurotic anxiety. They employ this form of psychological conditioning as a means of control. In the last century, socialists—National Socialists but particularly Communists—specialized in the technique to impose totalitarian control over whole societies. Their goal is to manipulate the population into a series of fear-based decisions that disconnect people from their traditions, history, and values—and from each other. Peter -

| | | I found some old photos. This one features my fellow Army Ranger graduates and me, 34 years ago at Ft. Benning, GA.

Washington's 10th Congressional District is home to JBLM, one of the largest active-duty military installations in the country. I'd be a proud fighter for our military and veterans in Congress.

We're gaining momentum in this race. I'm happy to announce SEAL PAC and the Washington State Farm Bureau have given their endorsements.

Independence Day is right around the corner. As we celebrate our country's birthday, we should realize we've got a lot ahead of us. Right now, Republicans in Congress and on the Supreme Court have one goal: undermine everything, remove all federal protections Americans rely on, and dismantle American democracy. [Democrats are going to come together to stop them.](http://r.garamendiforcongress.org/mk/cl/f/gO8LI9L2n-nYZ-DHziArAYhIBHC38QQ7bVzKKoz7yCTdEuvAuqJAXe7keiPgoi1iP_3Mi5uTFq1yDezl2i5j5AIxO9WzmG78n5VOc3rNWRbPV7Ij4KDKjlkGZt28-UVnsXqIlT221Eq64FUnUDdW2NcROXC4hgdtiAv7YlFZKErdSMOrNGuaFCynU50Ll4PDxnrmWsL9A0ThXYTsUYY_-fSJRObvihZMgC6LO-iRpKc) We are seeing it play out in real-time during the January 6th hearings. Trump and his cronies tried once to stage an insurrection against the American government. Now, the Supreme Court has [announced it will take up a case ](http://r.garamendiforcongress.org/mk/cl/f/muGg4umX6lKdKZHeSTLQ2uDqau3kDPoyqKy65VWQQM0XQ_l9IlqnnZHHt9dxtcUeOIyLcmSEa5lBqXxur_HNDzE6mWAKDtb8qsXcY9belBqBFQPsvkjhg9833ttRHKJB5ZrQ3HI0FX6d2VxO_joDkkhGcF0Cef7xc-8hKolcc_76whJsJaFvvqy-J7G5lMUZUyR_qMUvFXo0PKMwCrFuwU5XT52qGFddk5krs9F4RWvdF8PXUV56JHiBGvU4wNeXeFlkFGc2kwaHLMmsjWDRnjbcH9KLSo3DVllLVYi0Hx_UyZrnNuRPClIKDoF88jTVvUU01daoP62wb4zmPA)that will make it easier for Trump and his loyalists to succeed the next time they try. We are seeing it with the dismantling of a nearly 50-year protection for a woman’s right to choose. We are seeing it with the attacks on legislation to fight the climate crisis and protect our communities from floods, fires, hurricanes, and more. I have never been more concerned for the fate of American democracy throughout my life in public service than I am right now. We must be tough and fight back together. Today is a major fundraising deadline—one that will be reported publicly for all to see. Raising as much as possible before midnight tonight is imperative to fend off opponents and continue the fight to protect the soul of America. [Please, chip in $20, $50, $70, or whatever you can now. ](http://r.garamendiforcongress.org/mk/cl/f/dJ04ac8KIuUh8-FKxONhyQkqBbjKOgsJRKiv7R8g2zixEeFM0YVFjtl1GoHjyhbJwODVKrHzYdH98_U6xqfdgYeqtrBjLAQ4Vb7q-7SB6BCL7iwb-E0fZ_aVItUDdlh5KrcvT4ExLTwVXckUxaIFJ8mQZP6UjdphuqZNUzzBoxuZQL0RpDIBqmLxQ5tJHNTSqI20i6LwfEF6-6iR39xNg8IxOT7hftnTZp_zWDNtank) There’s so much at stake, and your support is more important now than ever. body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/7bfc2180fbcc/announcing-watermen-for-kelly-11817891?e=64ac72257a)
---
| | [ ](https://kellyschulzforgovernor.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05f3d1aa190e2cb084d25c5f0&id=9702d6bb5f&e=64ac72257a)
---
| |
# Dear Peter,

Today I held a press conference with Governor Larry Hogan, Maryland Republican Party Chairman Dirk Haire, and Republican members of the Maryland legislature to condemn Democratic interference in the Maryland Republican Primary.
---
| [ ](https://kellyschulzforgovernor.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05f3d1aa190e2cb084d25c5f0&id=0d2af4e01d&e=64ac72257a)
---
| [_Watch my press conference here_](https://kellyschulzforgovernor.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05f3d1aa190e2cb084d25c5f0&id=f2167b8dfa&e=64ac72257a)
---
| As of today, the Democratic Governors Association (DGA) has invested over ONE MILLION DOLLARS to prop up my opponent in an attempt to defeat me on July 19th.

**Any ad you see that is paid for by the DGA is an ad meant to trick you. Because they think you can be manipulated and easily fooled. **

These are the same people who spend most of their days claiming to care about saving democracy. But when it comes down to it, all they care about is their own political power. And this proves it.

The national Democrats can’t stand Governor Hogan and the success we have had. They can’t stand the Republican legislators who stood with me today. And frankly, they can’t stand me, because I am a threat. I’m a threat standing in the way of one-party rule in Annapolis.

So, what are we going to do?

**To put it simply, we’re going to fight back.**

_We won’t be fooled by their deceitful and shameless tactics._

Every single day, I am working to move our state in the right direction and will fight to keep changing Maryland for the better.

_As governor, all Marylanders can count on me to fight for them, and to bring real solutions to tackle inflation, taxes, education, and crime._

**Make no mistake about it, with your help, we are going to win.**

[**Can you please make a contribution of $25, $50, $75, $100 or even $250 today? **](https://kellyschulzforgovernor.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05f3d1aa190e2cb084d25c5f0&id=b1807f04ed&e=64ac72257a)

Together we will show the DGA that Maryland is not for sale.

Thank you,
---
|
---
| **Kelly Schulz**
Candidate for Governor

name: Joe Kent
subject: FW: Bad News, Worse News [JUST HOURS LEFT]
body:
Hi--
This is Joe's campaign manager. Did you see the email below? We have just hours left before the deadline tonight and we need your help.
I've spent hundreds of hours with Joe campaigning all over the district, and there's one thing I want to share with you about Joe: he never complains. No matter what the campaign needs him to do, he's always been willing. Hundreds of events, thousands of miles, tens of thousands of phone calls, Joe has never let up.
And I'm asking you not to let up either. Please, make a last minute emergency donation of whatever you can afford right now at [https://www.JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/mUI6HpL3JIWc4NKhC8kYMA/m892q892lUPG763IOhPekhdpxHZw).
Thank you,
Ozzie Gonzalez

**From:** Joe Kent
**Sent:** Tuesday, June 28, 2022 7:00 AM
**Subject:** Bad News, Worse News

Dear Supporter,
My campaign against Jaime Herrera Beutler is entering the final stages and the reporting deadline is just a few days away.
Will you make an emergency contribution today to please help me meet our budget? Please contribute at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/763PLtQvT3KEua334gTLAk5Q/m892q892lUPG763IOhPekhdpxHZw).
So first, the bad news.
It's unlikely that I will raise more money than Jaime this quarter. Because she voted to impeach President Trump, voted to fund Planned Parenthood with tax dollars, voted for red flag laws, and stands with the corporate elite on every issue, the Establishment rewards her with millions of dollars in campaign contributions.
Now here's the worse news: dark money groups have even more millions lined up to flood the airwaves of our district to try to buy her re-election. Big pharma, the Koch family, and extreme environmental groups are going to stop at nothing to re-elect her.
Will you help me level the playing field by making an end-of-quarter contribution at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/763PLtQvT3KEua334gTLAk5Q/m892q892lUPG763IOhPekhdpxHZw)?
The ruling elite don't support Jaime because they actually like her. They support her because they fear me and what I stand for. An unapologetic supporter of President Trump and a fighter for the America First cause is their worst nightmare.
So please -- in these final moments of the quarter and just a couple of weeks before the voting starts, send whatever you can afford at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/763PLtQvT3KEua334gTLAk5Q/m892q892lUPG763IOhPekhdpxHZw).
I've given this race everything I have. I've put in nearly $300,000 of my own money that I earned during a 20 year military career. I've done three-hundred events, driven thousands of miles, and have flown all over the country in search of the resources I need to fight the tide of establishment's money and influence.
And I promise I won't let up not for even a minute until the election is decided. I'm going to end this campaign either with my shield or on it.
Thank you,

Joe Kent
PS: Anything helps. [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/763PLtQvT3KEua334gTLAk5Q/m892q892lUPG763IOhPekhdpxHZw).

---
| | | It’s down to this: there’s only 6 hours left, Peter, before the books close on this hugely important general election end-of-quarter fundraising deadline. [If you haven’t chipped in yet, now is the time to help push us over the finish line with a gift of $25, $50 or $100.](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=9d35a15ed9&e=292fde286a)

I’ve been absolutely overwhelmed with the amount of support you have shown over the last few days, weeks, and months to put this grassroots movement on track for a massive win in November. Thanks to you, our campaign was the top vote-getter in this month’s primary, we’re consolidating the Democratic field, and we’ve solidified deep support among voters, community leaders, and elected officials in every corner of the district.

**But we need to finish this fundraising quarter — the first one of the general election — super strong to leave no doubt that CA15 voters want an experienced leader in Congress who has a proven record of delivering progressive results and the know-how to tackle the issues facing our region and our nation. **

In Congress, I’ll get to work on Day One to codify _Roe v. Wade_ , protect access to safe and legal abortion care, and fight back against every effort to restrict or criminalize it. And I’ll pick up in Washington where I left off in Sacramento safeguarding our democracy and the integrity of our elections, and taking bold action on climate change.

**Bottom line: I’m the proud proven progressive in this race — I won’t relinquish that title to anyone — and I’m ready to keep fighting for you in Congress. **

[So, I’m asking you one last time before tonight’s quarterly deadline, are you with us? Click here to donate before the clock strikes midnight.](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=63551be353&e=292fde286a)

I am so grateful for your support,

Kevin Mullin
